raw.description:
• Location: Fully Remote (Global)
  • Compensation: $24k to $36k USD Yearly
  • Position Type: Full-Time Contract

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly technical, impact-driven Senior Systems Engineer to own, scale, and protect our core email transmission infrastructure. In this role, your golden rule will be Reputation Above All. You are not just managing email lists or monitoring dashboards; you will architect and maintain the high-availability server infrastructure, Mail Transfer Agents (MTAs), and automated defensive systems that ensure our legitimate traffic hits the inbox while bad actors are ruthlessly contained.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between deep Linux systems administration, network engineering, and advanced email deliverability strategy. You will have a massive impact on the company by safeguarding our global IP/domain reputation, minimizing blast radiuses, and ensuring zero-downtime mail operations across our entire infrastructure network.

Core Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Management & High Availability

  • MTA Optimization: Maintain and configure core MTAs (Postfix, Postal) and IMAP/POP3 servers (Dovecot), ensuring graceful reloads over restarts to prevent dropping active connections.
  • Traffic Routing & Load Balancing: Utilize HAProxy and network routing protocols (like BGP via FRRouting) to distribute outbound traffic and architect high-volume failover mechanisms.
  • Redundancy & Failover: Administer backend infrastructure databases (PostgreSQL replica setups) and maintain dedicated "Block" backup/archive servers to instantly take over the workload of a failed primary "Cube" server.
  • Architectural Segregation: Maintain strict workload isolation across our infrastructure network—separating standard nodes for mail stacks, specialized injection nodes (Postal), and separate archiving/backup systems to prevent high-volume senders from degrading performance.

2. Deliverability Engine & Authentication Protocol Architecture

  • Protocol Enforcement: Act as the absolute technical authority on DNS and authentication setups, maintaining flawless configurations for SPF (navigating the 10-lookup limit), DKIM (key rotation and forwarding protection), DMARC (safely driving policies toward p=reject), and BIMI.
  • Traffic Throttling: Implement automated, MTA-level dynamic throttling to handle 4xx deferrals instantly, preventing a single high-volume sender from triggering global rate limits across our shared IP pools.
  • Warm-up Strategy: Design and guide automated IP/Domain Warm-up Plans for new infrastructure, managing incremental volume scaling over 2–4 week cycles.

3. Edge Security, Anti-Abuse & Incident Response

  • Outbound Spam Filtering: Configure and optimize Rspamd to actively scan, flag, and quarantine highly spammy content before it exits our network.
  • Edge Defense: Deploy automated connection-dropping systems (Fail2Ban, custom SMTP blocker scripts) to mitigate authenticated attacks, brute-force attempts, and malicious traffic.
  • Blast Radius Mitigation: Program and maintain a dynamic IP pooling engine ("The Penalty Box") to instantly isolate accounts displaying poor metrics (bounces, FBL spikes) away from prime Tier-1 IP pools.
  • Blocklist Remediation: Act as the primary responder to major DNSBL (e.g., Spamhaus) listings. Leverage log analysis to locate the root cause account, plug the security leak, and submit expert delisting requests.

4. Observability & Monitoring

  • Log Shipping Architecture: Build and manage high-performance log aggregation pipelines using Vector to ship system and MTA data into a centralized repository for real-time auditing and incident response.
  • Network Auditing: Utilize IPAudit and custom tools to continuously scan for bandwidth anomalies, connection spikes, or compromised user credentials.
  • Dashboard Management: Actively monitor ISP infrastructure portals daily (Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, Yahoo Sender Hub) along with third-party tracking tools (GlockApps, Validity/ReturnPath, MXToolbox, DMARCian).

Requirements

Must-Have Technical Stack & Skills:

  • Systems Engineering Background: 5+ years of experience as a Linux Systems Administrator, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineer with deep networking knowledge (TCP/IP, routing, ports, DNS management).
  • MTA Mastery: Expert-level proficiency configuring, debugging, and optimizing enterprise mail tools such as Postfix, Dovecot, or Postal.
  • Security & Filtering: Hands-on experience writing rules and maintaining mail-filtering/anti-abuse applications like Rspamd and Fail2Ban.
  • Observability Pipelines: Proven experience building or maintaining log pipelines using Vector or similar high-scale telemetry frameworks.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Experience implementing network routing layer tools (HAProxy, FRRouting) and relational databases (PostgreSQL replication).
  • Certificate Management: Strong familiarity with automated SSL/TLS certificate rotation and multi-node compliance monitoring to ensure broken TLS never causes silent drops.

Deliverability & Operational Standards:

  • Deep comprehension of the difference between Delivery (server handoff) and Deliverability (inbox placement).
  • Expert parsing of aggregate DMARC reports using platforms like DMARCian, Valimail, or Postmark.
  • Strict commitment to Acceptable Use Policies (AUP): zero tolerance for purchased/scraped lists and a firm grasp on Feedback Loop (FBL) automated triage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your success in this role will be directly measured by your ability to keep our infrastructure metrics pristine:

  • Global Infrastructure Spam Complaint Rate: Maintained strictly under 0.1%.
  • Global Hard Bounce Rate: Kept consistently below 2.0%.
  • Infrastructure Uptime: 99.99% availability across all outbound MTAs and mail relays.
  • Incident Isolation Time: Transitioning high-risk or abusive senders to the "Penalty Box" or circuit-breaking campaigns within minutes of a threshold breach.

Benefits

This is a highly technical systems engineering role, not a marketing or email campaign management position. To be considered, you must have hands-on experience configuring Linux mail servers at the command-line level. Please confirm upon applying that the compensation range of $24,000 to $36,000 USD per year aligns with your expectations.

PURPOSE

Leads complex, enterprise-wide strategic programs and transformation initiatives critical to achieving corporate objectives. Partners with executive and senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, align cross-functional teams, accelerate decision-making, and drive realization of intended business outcomes. The Principal Program Manager operates across business, technology, deployment, change management, and support organizations, driving integrated execution and accountability across teams without direct authority.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Scope of role: Leads enterprise strategic programs and cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, operational readiness, adoption, and value realization. Serves as a trusted advisor to IT Delivery Leadership and brings structure, transparency, and forward momentum to complex transformation priorities. Delivery and Execution

Establish integrated delivery strategies, governance, milestones, and operating rhythms for complex enterprise transformation initiatives. Drive execution across multiple concurrent business and technology workstreams, ensuring dependencies, risks, decisions, and commitments are actively managed. Maintain an integrated view of program critical path, organizational readiness, major dependencies, and barriers to successful delivery. Hold workstream leaders accountable for commitments and proactively drive corrective action when execution is at risk. Anticipate delivery challenges and resolve issues before they require executive escalation.

Strategic Planning and Alignment

Partner with executive and senior leadership to translate strategic objectives into actionable roadmaps, priorities, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes. Facilitate alignment across business, technology, deployment, change management, support functions, and external partners. Identify and resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies that impede execution. Connect program priorities and investments to enterprise strategy and expected business value.

Executive Leadership and Decision Support

Provide concise analysis, recommendations, scenarios, and briefing materials that enable timely executive decisions. Maintain visibility into significant program decisions, unresolved issues, dependencies, and required executive actions. Frame complex issues into clear decisions, options, trade-offs, recommendations, and consequences. Drive strategic decisions to conclusion and ensure resulting actions and commitments are executed. Escalate issues requiring executive intervention while driving program-level resolution at the appropriate organizational level.

Leadership Team Coordination

Establish mechanisms that maintain alignment across solution delivery leadership, business stakeholders, functional towers, and supporting teams. Ensure strategic priorities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and commitments remain visible across leadership and delivery organizations. Facilitate cross-functional leadership discussions needed to resolve competing priorities and execution barriers. Drive follow-through on commitments resulting from Solution Leadership and Executive Leadership decisions.

Executive and Strategic Communications

Develop executive-level communications that clearly articulate program progress, accomplishments, risks, decisions, business impacts, and strategic direction. Translate complex technology and transformation topics into clear business implications and executive-level narratives. Partner with organizational change management and communications teams to maintain consistent messaging across stakeholder groups. Ensure reporting emphasizes outcomes, decisions, emerging risks, and required actions rather than activity reporting alone.

Strategic Initiatives and Transformation

Lead strategic initiatives and special projects on behalf of IT Delivery Leadership. Drive initiatives spanning multiple programs, functional towers, delivery workstreams, or organizational boundaries. Assess organizational effectiveness, transformation readiness, adoption, operating-model effectiveness, and value realization. Develop business cases, investment recommendations, transformation roadmaps, and materials for executive strategy discussions. Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, governance, organizational structures, technology practices, and ways of working.

Value Realization and Business Outcomes

Establish measurable outcomes and success criteria for strategic programs and initiatives. Connect program milestones and technology deliverables to business outcomes, adoption, operational readiness, and expected value. Identify when delivery activity or technical completion is not translating into intended business results. Partner with business and technology leaders to develop corrective actions when expected outcomes are at risk.

Risk, Dependency, and Issue Management

Proactively identify systemic risks, cross-program dependencies, critical decisions, and organizational constraints. Drive ownership and resolution of risks and issues rather than relying primarily on escalation. Ensure material risks include clear ownership, mitigation actions, decision points, and business implications. Provide leadership with early visibility into emerging risks and potential impacts to strategic outcomes.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, experience, and relevant certifications. Typically 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in program leadership, transformation, strategy, consulting, technology delivery, business operations, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation or technology programs with more than eight concurrent workstreams. Demonstrated experience supporting and interacting with C-suite, EVP, SVP, or major transformation leaders. Demonstrated success operating in complex, matrixed organizations and driving accountability without direct authority. Experience translating complex issues into executive decisions, recommendations, and actionable follow-through. Experience managing cross-functional dependencies, risks, priorities, and organizational challenges from strategy through value realization.

Drives accountability without direct authority. Anticipates risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers before they become executive escalations. About the Role

The Governance, Risk & Compliance Lead (Corporate & Regulatory Compliance) oversee and coordinate corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and statutory requirements for an international organization.

In this role, you will work closely with senior leadership and key departments, including Legal, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and Information Security, to ensure that regulatory obligations are properly monitored, documented, and completed on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional looking to take on a strategic, cross-functional role in a multinational business environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance: Maintain and oversee the company's compliance framework, statutory obligations, regulatory requirements, and annual compliance calendar.
  • Government & Regulatory Coordination: Coordinate compliance activities involving Philippine regulatory bodies, including the SEC, BIR, LGUs, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, Board of Investments (BOI), and other relevant agencies.
  • BOI Compliance & Licensing: Monitor BOI registration conditions, reporting obligations, regulatory requirements, incentive compliance, and supporting documentation.
  • Risk Management & Monitoring: Identify compliance risks, monitor regulatory changes, track potential violations, and coordinate corrective actions to prevent penalties and compliance breaches.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Legal, HR, Finance, Operations, and Information Security teams to ensure compliance requirements have clear owners, deadlines, and supporting documentation.
  • Compliance Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate compliance registers, audit records, permits, licenses, regulatory filings, and management reports.
  • Audit & Regulatory Support: Coordinate internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, compliance reviews, and the resolution of identified findings.
  • Process Improvement: Develop and maintain compliance procedures, monitoring tools, checklists, and governance controls to strengthen regulatory readiness.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, Human Resources, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Relevant professional experience in corporate governance, regulatory compliance, legal operations, risk management, internal audit, or a similar compliance function.
  • Working knowledge of Philippine statutory and regulatory requirements, particularly those involving the SEC, BIR, LGUs, and other government agencies.
  • Experience coordinating regulatory filings, compliance documentation, statutory registrations, permits, and compliance deadlines.
  • Ability to manage compliance calendars, regulatory trackers, action plans, and audit documentation.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with senior management and cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of Philippine data privacy requirements and GDPR.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling BOI registration conditions, compliance obligations, and government incentive requirements.
  • Experience working in a multinational company, shared services organization, or Global Capability Center (GCC).
  • Professional qualifications such as CPA, lawyer, Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or relevant compliance or risk management certifications are an advantage but not mandatory.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Take on a company-wide role with direct exposure to senior leadership.
  • Collaborate with multiple business functions and international stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of corporate governance and compliance processes.
  • Gain exposure to a broad range of Philippine regulatory and statutory compliance matters.

We Are Bring IT!

We are a dynamic, and fast-growing professional services company bringing digital transformation to our clients around the world. From launching products to market to driving productivity with the right technology and processes, the work we do is improving the way people work. To achieve this, we are building a global and diverse team capable of tackling some of today’s most important challenges. We call this unique approach “360 Success.”

We are recognized as one of the fastest-growing and most successful companies in the INC5000 ranking in the U.S. 🇺🇸, and we are opening new offices around the world to continue growing, exploring, and diversifying. With more than 10 recognitions from our partners, we continue to lead in our markets.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on accounting professional to execute a full books clean-up for a growing multi-location, multi-entity, clinic-based mental healthcare business in the US. Working closely with the CFO, you’ll reconcile, correct and document the books until they are close-ready. It’s a great opportunity to grow into a full Controller role.

What you’ll do

  • Revenue cycle & ASC 606: Record contractual allowances, denials and patient responsibility, and reconcile billing and EHR data to the GL.
  • AR clean-up: Rebuild and reconcile AR by entity, location and payer, apply the reserve methodology and resolve unapplied cash.
  • AP & accruals: Clean up the AP subledger, perform vendor reconciliations and prepare cutoff and month-end accruals.
  • Payroll: Prepare accruals for payroll, benefits, bonuses and provider compensation, and reconcile them to the GL.
  • ASC 842 leases: Inventory clinic and equipment leases, and maintain ROU asset and lease liability schedules.
  • Inventory & GL review: Correct medical supply inventory entries, prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the P&L review.
  • Intercompany: Record and reconcile intercompany transactions and support the consolidation process.
  • Documentation: Document processes and help build a repeatable month-end close.

What you bring

  • 4–7 years of accounting experience, ideally as a Senior Accountant, Accounting Manager or Assistant Controller
  • Healthcare industry experience, ideally in multi-site or clinic-based organizations (must)
  • QuickBooks proficiency (must)
  • Hands-on experience with account reconciliations, accruals and month-end close
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP, including ASC 606 and ASC 842
  • Exposure to intercompany accounting in a multi-entity environment
  • Detail-oriented, organized and comfortable working through messy data
  • Advanced English

Nice to have

  • Experience with books clean-up projects
  • Experience with RCM or EHR billing systems
  • Background in mental or behavioral healthcare
  • CPA, or working toward it

Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist – Remote | Part-Time

Position Type: Part-Time, Remote
Schedule: Less than 30 hours/week
Location: Remote — Open Worldwide

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist to strengthen client relationships, improve the customer experience, and reduce churn.

This role is focused on what happens after a client comes onboard — making sure customers see value, stay engaged, receive proactive support, and have compelling reasons to continue the relationship.

You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, and operations to improve the customer journey from onboarding through long-term retention.

If you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Retention, or Customer Experience and enjoy building lasting client relationships, this could be a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Success & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Conduct proactive client check-ins and follow-ups
  • Understand client goals, concerns, and expectations
  • Identify potential issues before they become reasons for churn
  • Ensure clients consistently receive a responsive and professional experience

Client Retention & Churn Reduction

  • Develop and execute strategies to improve client retention
  • Identify customers who may be disengaged or at risk of leaving
  • Investigate the reasons behind churn and dissatisfaction
  • Create proactive outreach and re-engagement strategies
  • Recommend improvements that increase customer loyalty and long-term value
  • Support renewal conversations where applicable

Customer Journey Optimization

  • Review the full customer journey from onboarding through ongoing engagement
  • Identify friction points, communication gaps, and opportunities for improvement
  • Help create a more consistent and engaging client experience
  • Work with internal teams to implement customer experience improvements
  • Ensure onboarding sets clear expectations and positions clients for long-term success

Customer Feedback & Insights

  • Gather customer feedback through:
    • Client conversations
    • Surveys
    • NPS
    • CSAT
    • Ongoing account interactions
  • Identify patterns and recurring client concerns
  • Translate feedback into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Share customer insights with leadership and relevant teams

Customer Success Metrics & Reporting

Monitor and report on metrics such as:

  • Client retention rate
  • Customer churn
  • NPS
  • CSAT
  • Customer engagement
  • Renewal performance

Use customer data and feedback to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales, operations, and leadership teams
  • Communicate customer needs and recurring pain points internally
  • Help improve handoffs between sales, onboarding, and ongoing customer support
  • Support initiatives designed to improve retention and customer lifetime value

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Naturally build trust and strong client relationships
  • Are proactive rather than waiting for customers to complain
  • Understand why customers churn and how to reduce it
  • Communicate confidently and professionally
  • Balance empathy with business objectives
  • Are comfortable working with customer data and performance metrics
  • Can turn customer feedback into actionable improvements
  • Are organized and capable of working independently

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in:
    • Customer Success
    • Account Management
    • Client Retention
    • or a closely related client-facing role
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Customer lifecycle management
    • Client engagement
    • Retention strategies
    • Churn reduction
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • or similar systems
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret customer feedback and performance metrics
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection and availability within the agreed part-time schedule

Nice to Have

  • Experience in:
    • Real estate
    • SaaS
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as:
    • Gainsight
    • ChurnZero
    • Intercom
  • Experience managing:
    • Renewals
    • Upselling
    • Cross-selling
    • At-risk accounts
  • Familiarity with NPS, CSAT, churn, and retention reporting

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing client health and engagement
  • Reaching out proactively to existing customers
  • Following up with clients who may be at risk of churning
  • Supporting onboarding and early customer engagement
  • Gathering and analyzing client feedback
  • Reviewing retention, NPS, and CSAT trends
  • Coordinating with sales and operations on customer issues
  • Identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey
  • Preparing retention insights and recommendations for leadership

In short: you make sure clients feel supported, see continued value, and want to stay.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved customer retention
  • Reduced client churn
  • Strong NPS and CSAT scores
  • Consistent client engagement and follow-up
  • Successful onboarding and early-stage adoption
  • Improved customer experience across the lifecycle
  • Clear identification and recovery of at-risk clients
  • Actionable customer feedback delivered to leadership

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote and open worldwide
  • Flexible part-time schedule
  • Direct impact on customer retention and business growth
  • Opportunity to shape the customer journey and retention strategy
  • Close collaboration with leadership
  • Long-term growth potential as the company scales

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After applying, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to complete a short Intro Video. This self-recorded video helps the hiring team learn more about your experience and communication before the client interview.

You can complete it on your own time and re-record your responses before submitting if needed.

Please check both your inbox and spam/junk folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Retention
  • Know how to build strong client relationships
  • Enjoy identifying and preventing churn
  • Are comfortable using customer data and feedback to improve retention
  • Want a flexible, part-time remote opportunity

We’d love to hear from you.

We are seeking an experienced and seasoned technology professional to join us as a Senior Technical Solution Architect within our Presales / Sales Engineering organization. You will specialize in Application-to-Application (A2A), Business-to-Business (B2B) or EDI, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integrations, driving technical win strategies and bridging enterprise platforms with next-generation cognitive systems.

If you are a deep integration expert skilled in customer engagement, modern enterprise middleware, API strategies, and AI Agent integration layers, this is the perfect opportunity to drive significant impact across our presales engagements and global enterprise sales cycle.

In addition, you will serve as the technical authority during presales discoveries, architectural workshops, and solution demonstrations, partnering closely with sales leadership and business consultants. You will be providing customer-driven feedback to Product R&D as well.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Technical Discovery & Customer Exchanges: Conduct deep-dive technical discovery sessions, lead advanced architectural exchanges with prospective clients, and articulate complex enterprise integration strategies to key business and technical stakeholders.
  • Integrate via Enterprise Tools: Architect enterprise-grade integrations, based on our QAD Integration Platform and through middleware, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), and ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) platforms.
  • Master Protocols & API Layers: Design robust integration via API and protocol layers utilizing REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and other modern communication frameworks.
  • Demonstrate Integration Platform and AI Solutions: Present and demonstrate advanced integration capabilities with 3rd party applications and AI Agents, cognitive workflows to client executives and technical panels.
  • Presales Partnership: Partner directly with Account Executives and Business Consultants to respond to complex RFPs/RFIs, address technical objections, validate solution feasibility, and ensure seamless handoffs to Implementation Services.
  • Create Architectural Blueprints: Develop, maintain, and own high-quality technical diagrams, data-flow schemas, and system topology designs for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployments.
  • Engage C-Level Stakeholders: Direct and lead deep technical discovery and architectural discussions with top-tier prospects, customers, and key enterprise executives.
  • Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
  • An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
  • Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Advanced Integration Skills: 10+ years of professional experience in technical solutions architecture, system integration, or software engineering.
  • Cloud & SaaS Expertise: Proven experience managing and architecting within Cloud and SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of security protocols, data privacy, and compliance.
  • A2A, B2B & B2G Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of Application-to-Application (A2A) flows, Business-to-Business (B2B) standards, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integration frameworks
  • AI Integration Layer Mastery: Strong capability and current technical knowledge of AI Agent integration layers, large language model (LLM) orchestration pipelines, and cognitive agent frameworks.
  • API & Protocols: Full command of RESTful APIs, SOAP, web services, microservices design patterns, and routing topologies.
  • Enterprise Tooling: Mastery of middleware platforms (e.g., Boomi, MuleSoft, or equivalent), ETL, and ESB systems.
  • ERP Landscapes: Strong familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial enterprise software landscapes is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical jargon into business value for C-level executives.
  • Customer Engagement & Presales Track Record: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, delivering compelling technical demonstrations, and leading architectural workshops for customer stakeholders.
  • Language Proficiency: Excellent English (verbal and written), additional European languages, especially French and German, will be appreciated.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional qualifications.
  • Relevant industry certifications (PMP, Boomi/MuleSoft Architect, AI/LLM Engineering, or AWS/Azure Solution Architect) are highly valued.
  • Your health and well-being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
  • Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
  • An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.

Compensation Package

  • Compensation will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
  • Local country-based benefits package.

Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

We are a virtual-first company, and your primary work experience will be virtual / working from your home, when not traveling to customer or prospect facilities in this specific role. Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Solutions Engineering to lead technical pre-sales and solution design for our data center customers. Partnering closely with Sales, this role owns the technical evaluation stage on priority AI and Hyperscale opportunities, translating complex customer requirements into scalable, standards-based solutions, proposals, and cost estimates. As a member of the team, you will develop and put in place the templates, tools, and processes the function runs on. You will work with Sales, Operations, Design, Construction, Finance, and Supplier partners to make sure what we sell can be delivered, driving strong customer outcomes and contract value.

  • Lead solution requirement sessions with clients and vendors, delivering technical proposals, architectural overviews, and facility tours
  • Support Sales in positioning solutions and reviewing technical exhibits and lease terms, ensuring commitments align with what our sites can deliver
  • Conduct detailed assessments of power, cooling, network, and space requirements for customer deployments
  • Develop and review cost estimates, bills of materials, and scopes of work for large-scale infrastructure deployments

  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ESPECIALISTA DESENVOLVEDORA BACKEND NA YDUQS.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ESPECIALISTA DESENVOLVEDORA BACKEND são:

  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade utilizando e AWS;
  • Garantir a integração eficiente entre sistemas internos e externos, usando SNS, SQS, Lambda e outras tecnologias relevantes;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB e DynamoDB;
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar soluções escaláveis e resilientes em ambientes de produção.

Buscamos profissionais com:

  • Superior completo em tecnologia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida compara construção de microsserviços e APIs;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos e experiência dos principais serviços da AWS, como EKS, SNS, SQS, Lambda, MongoDB Atlas e DynamoDB;
  • Familiaridade com Step Functions da AWS;
  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços, integração de sistemas e automação de processos;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD, controle de versão (Git), e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend ou Desenvolvedor(a) de Microsserviços, com forte foco em;
  • Vivência com práticas de integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD);
  • Familiaridade com o desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e protocolos de comunicação assíncrona;
  • Conhecimento em contêineres (Docker) e orquestração de contêineres com Kubernetes (EKS);
  • Experiência com monitoramento de sistemas e gestão de logs (AWS CloudWatch, ELK, etc.);
  • Habilidade em debugging, performance tuning e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar e colaborar de forma eficiente com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Compromisso com a qualidade do código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Consideramos como diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em AWS Step Functions;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform, Azure DevOps);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e patterns de integração (API Gateway, Event Sourcing, CQRS);
  • Certificação AWS (ex.: Solutions Architect, Developer);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Remoto.

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar:

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Wellhub ou Totalpass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Wellzuma plataforma voltada para a saúde mental e emocional dos colaboradores que oferece diversos tipos de acompanhamento, dentre eles acesso a terapias online individuais
  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado e vantagens exclusivas;
  • Dress code flexível para promover a nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo, Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.
  • Day Off de Aniversário.

💻 Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios corporativos da companhia.

📅 Horário Flexível, contamos com política de Horário Flexível para colaboradores administrativos do corporativo, com opções de jornada dentro das faixas definidas pela companhia, inclusive para o home office.

🤰 Trabalho remoto (home office) estendido para as mães e pais recém-chegados da licença maternidade por até 3 meses, de acordo com a função desenvolvida.

🎓Acreditamos na excelência do nosso ensino e, por isso, valorizamos os egressos das nossas instituições em nossos processos seletivos.

🔵 Compromisso com a inclusão: todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, reforçando o quanto valorizamos a diversidade

DIVERSIDADE: A YDUQS valoriza a diversidade e as informações adicionais prestadas nos campos de diversidade são muito importantes para nós, por isso pedimos para que não deixe de responder.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera.

raw.title: Senior Business Analyst
raw.excerpt: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera.
raw.description:
Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.

Vas a ser el puente entre el negocio, el cliente y el equipo de desarrollo. Tu trabajo es asegurar que el equipo construya lo correcto: entender las necesidades, traducirlas en un backlog claro y accionable, y ayudar a priorizar siempre con foco en el objetivo del producto.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

  • Analizar y documentar las diferentes características de un producto, considerando tanto aspectos de negocio como técnicos.
  • Aplicar buenas prácticas al momento de definir un backlog y documentar historias de usuario
  • Facilitar y participar activamente en reuniones de entendimiento de requerimientos.
  • Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de desarrollo.
  • Ayudar al cliente y al equipo a trabajar el alcance dentro de un marco ágil, siempre con foco en el objetivo del producto.
  • Actualizar las prioridades del product backlog según el roadmap, negociando con el Product Owner.
  • Atender las dependencias que puedan impactar en el objetivo del proyecto.
  • Incentivar al equipo a tomar un rol activo en los refinamientos.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

  • Experiencia documentando y realizando historias de usuario, diagramas UML.
  • Moderar reuniones efectivas
  • Conocimientos de servicios y la capacidad de testearlos a través de distintas herramientas.
  • Entendimiento de la arquitectura de un sistema es una gran ventaja.
  • Experiencia haciendo slicing de una funcionalidad.
  • Capacidad analítica y skills de negociación.
  • Experiencia en story mapping, impact mapping, bocetado, etc.

¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?

En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.
En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

raw.excerpt: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera.
raw.description:
Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad.

Vas a ser el puente entre el negocio, el cliente y el equipo de desarrollo. Tu trabajo es asegurar que el equipo construya lo correcto: entender las necesidades, traducirlas en un backlog claro y accionable, y ayudar a priorizar siempre con foco en el objetivo del producto.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

  • Analizar y documentar las diferentes características de un producto, considerando tanto aspectos de negocio como técnicos.
  • Aplicar buenas prácticas al momento de definir un backlog y documentar historias de usuario
  • Facilitar y participar activamente en reuniones de entendimiento de requerimientos.
  • Trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de desarrollo.
  • Ayudar al cliente y al equipo a trabajar el alcance dentro de un marco ágil, siempre con foco en el objetivo del producto.
  • Actualizar las prioridades del product backlog según el roadmap, negociando con el Product Owner.
  • Atender las dependencias que puedan impactar en el objetivo del proyecto.
  • Incentivar al equipo a tomar un rol activo en los refinamientos.

¿Qué esperamos de vos?

  • Experiencia documentando y realizando historias de usuario, diagramas UML.
  • Moderar reuniones efectivas
  • Conocimientos de servicios y la capacidad de testearlos a través de distintas herramientas.
  • Entendimiento de la arquitectura de un sistema es una gran ventaja.
  • Experiencia haciendo slicing de una funcionalidad.
  • Capacidad analítica y skills de negociación.
  • Experiencia en story mapping, impact mapping, bocetado, etc.

¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor?

En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee.
En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

Title:Database Administrator

Department:Membership, Business Development, & Events

FLSA Classification:Exempt

Reports to:Director of MBDE

PositionSummary:

The Database Administrator serves as the technical administrator and steward of DMEC's CRM and related systems, including Salesforce and Nimble AMS. This role is responsible for system administration, data quality, integrations, workflows and configuration, reporting and dashboards, troubleshooting, testing and deployments, security, and overall system reliability. The Database Administrator partners with staff, vendors, and stakeholders across the organization to implement solutions that support business processes, operational efficiency, and member experience.

Job Duties andResponsibilities:

CRM, AMS, and Systems Administration

  • Serves as the primary administrator for Salesforce, Nimble AMS, and related systems.
  • Independently manages day-to-day system administration, exercising judgment to prioritize work, address issues, and implement improvements.
  • Configures and maintains workflows, automations, permissions, system settings, and other platform functionality.
  • Evaluates system enhancements, releases, and new features and develops recommendations for implementation.
  • Manages system updates, testing, deployments, security, and overall system reliability.

Data Quality, Reporting, and Analytics

  • Develops and maintains data quality standards and governance practices to ensure records are complete, accurate, secure, and effectively managed.
  • Maintains and improves data integrity through validation, deduplication, audits, migrations, and ongoing database maintenance.
  • Develops reports, dashboards, and data insights to support organizational planning, decision-making, membership growth, and operational effectiveness.
  • Analyzes membership and organizational data and recommends process and system improvements.

Integrations, Support, and Collaboration

  • Develops, maintains, and monitors integrations between Salesforce, Nimble AMS, learning management systems, marketing automation platforms, webinar platforms, and other connected systems.
  • Troubleshoots system and integration issues and coordinates resolution with vendors and technical partners.
  • Partners with the Membership, Business Development, & Events team, internal stakeholders, and external Salesforce and Nimble AMS partners to identify business needs and recommend system solutions.
  • Provides Tier 2 technical support to internal and external users, including troubleshooting issues, fulfilling requests, and improving system usability.
  • Develops and maintains system documentation, business processes, and user procedures to support business continuity and user adoption.
  • Assists with and leads training, testing, andimplementationactivities for system enhancements and projects.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Supports special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Knowledge,SkillsandAbilities:

(Knowledge, skills,andabilitiesarethequalifications an individualneedsin order toperformthe essentialfunctionsofthejob.)

  • Excellent customer service, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, and data quality and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical audiences and collaborate across departments.
  • Knowledge of data governance, reporting, and database administration best practices.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Education & Experience:

(The minimum educational and experience level qualifications an individual needsin order toperformthe essentialfunctionsofthejob.)

  • Bachelor's degree in business information systems (or a related field)or anAssociate’sdegree in a relevant field with 3+ years of experience in database administrationrequired
  • Certified Salesforce Administrator (201) required
  • Experience administering Nimble AMS strongly preferred. Candidates without Nimble AMS experience should demonstrate experience supporting complex Salesforce-based systems and integrations.
  • Experience working within a membership association, nonprofit organization, trade association, or professional society preferred.
  • Experience with learning management systems preferred.
  • Experience using data cleansing, migration, or data management tools preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Adobe products.

Work Environment:

  • This is a remote position. A quiet and professional home office environment is required.
  • Limited travel, including attendance at DMEC conferences and meetings, is required several times per year.

Salary & Benefits:

The hiring range for this position is $85,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

This is a summary of the current basic employment benefits. Individual benefit programs may be amended or deleted at management’s sole discretion at any time. An employee handbook will be provided to you upon hire for more complete information about DMEC’s benefit plans.

Employees are eligible on the date of hire for the following benefits:

  • 40 hours of paid sick leave per calendar year, unless a greater amount is required under state of local law
  • 4.62 vacation hours accrued per pay period (3 weeks per year)
  • 40 hours of bereavement leave
  • 401K retirement plan with 100% company match up to 4% of salary
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Eight (8) holidays, plus your birthday (floating holiday); in addition, the DMEC office is closed for two days following each in-person conference (2 conferences per year), and Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day each year (employees will be paid for any workdays that fall during that period)

Employees become eligible for group health and welfare benefits on the first of the month after completion of 30 days of employment.

  • Fully paid health, dental, vision, group life, and disability insurance (short-term and long-term)

Employees are eligible on the first of the month following 60 days of employment for the following benefits:

  • 80 hours of Paid Family Leave per year

Equipment:

DMEC will provide the necessary computer equipment (laptop and printer) for the employee’s home office as well as a monthly technology stipend of $100.

raw.excerpt: Senior Software Engineer, Back End – Accounting & TreasuryAbout CalizaCaliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders.
raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Back End – Accounting & Treasury

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

Every payment Caliza processes has to be recorded exactly once, in the right amount, in the right currency, and reconciled against what actually happened at the bank or on-chain. Our accounting and treasury systems are the source of truth for where every dollar and stablecoin sits, and they need to be correct even when payments are returned, reversed or delayed.

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Accounting & Treasury team, you'll build and own those systems: our double-entry ledger, reconciliation against bank accounts and stablecoin wallets, the recording of fiat–stablecoin conversions, and the tooling that helps us manage liquidity across payment rails. You'll work closely with our finance, compliance and payment operations teams.

Location: Remote. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

  • Design and build, from scratch, the system that tracks and accounts for our yield and financing instruments.

  • Learn our ledger and money flows end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoin wallets.

  • Reduce the manual reconciliation work our operations and finance teams do today.

  • Improve the visibility of balances and liquidity positions across rails and currencies.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, build and maintain ledger and treasury services in Kotlin and Spring Boot.

  • Model money movement correctly with double-entry accounting, including returns, reversals, fees and FX.

  • Build reconciliation between our ledger, bank statements and on-chain wallet balances, and surface breaks clearly.

  • Make our systems idempotent and resilient, so retries and partial failures never create or lose money.

  • Maintain immutable audit trails that support finance, compliance and external audits.

  • Build the data and tooling that support liquidity management.

  • Model yield-bearing and financing instruments in the ledger, from simple to complex.

  • Write thorough tests and review your teammates' code.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of professional back-end development experience.

  • Experience building ledgers, accounting systems, or other systems where correctness of money is critical.

  • A solid understanding of double-entry accounting: debits, credits, balances and reconciliation.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin or Java (we use Kotlin), and relational databases such as Postgres.

  • Experience with exact decimal arithmetic, idempotency, and consistency in distributed systems.

  • Experience with message-driven architectures (e.g. RabbitMQ).

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce.

  • Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

  • Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a payments company, bank, or fintech, ideally with treasury or settlement.

  • Familiarity with bank statement formats and payment messages (e.g. ISO 20022 camt.053, BAI2).

  • Experience with stablecoins, custody wallets, or on-chain reconciliation.

  • Experience with FX, multi-currency accounting, or liquidity management.

  • Experience with yield-bearing or financing instruments (e.g. money market funds, treasury bills, credit facilities).

  • Experience supporting audits or regulatory reporting.

How we work

We use AI coding tools every day and expect you to as well. They make us faster at the routine parts of the work. But you own every line you ship: you understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. That matters even more for systems that hold the source of truth for money. Because we handle financial data, we follow clear rules about what code and data can go into which tools.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

About InOutsource
InOutsource is a recognized industry leader in information governance and new business intake consulting for large law firms. We partner with clients to deliver technical implementation services, modernize business processes, and support the successful adoption of key technologies across the legal sector. Our team members are innovative, passionate, and collaborative, and we are growing!

Job Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Project Management team and serve as a trusted advisor to our clients while driving successful project delivery. This role requires a unique blend of client relationship management, organizational excellence, and technical project leadership to ensure our engagements exceed client expectations and deliver measurable business value. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of project management experience, strong stakeholder communication skills, and a proven track record of managing complex projects from initiation through delivery. This position does not have direct reports but requires collaboration across cross-functional teams and external client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities & Duties:
  • Lead end-to-end project delivery for professional services engagements, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget
  • Serve as the primary client liaison, building strong relationships and maintaining regular communication on project status, risks, and opportunities
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, deliverables, and success metrics
  • Facilitate requirements gathering sessions and translate business needs into actionable project deliverables and user stories
  • Lead change management initiatives using structured methodologies to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, and organizational changes
  • Conduct business analysis activities to identify process improvements, efficiency gains, and strategic recommendations for clients
  • Manage project risks and issues proactively, developing mitigation strategies and escalating appropriately when needed
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and resources to ensure alignment and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle
  • Create and maintain project documentation including charters, status reports, meeting notes, and lessons learned
  • Monitor project budgets, track actuals versus forecasts, and provide financial reporting to leadership
  • Facilitate project meetings including kickoffs, status reviews, steering committees, and retrospectives
  • Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards, methodologies, and best practices
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in project management, preferably in a professional services or consulting environment
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification, or equivalent training
  • PROSCI Change Management certification or equivalent training
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects valued at $500k+
  • Demonstrated experience managing change using ADKAR methodology
  • Strong risk, issue, and dependency management experience
  • Experience leading steering committees and executive status reporting
  • Experience managing project financials and forecasting
  • Exceptional client-facing skills with the ability to build rapport, manage expectations, and navigate challenging conversations
  • Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail and follow-through
  • Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills
  • Proven resource planning and capacity management experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all organizational levels
  • Experience creating user stories and working within Agile or hybrid project frameworks
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of business analysis techniques including requirements gathering, process mapping, and gap analysis
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think critically under pressure
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and related certifications (CSM, PMI-ACP)
  • Background in technology implementation projects or software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with legal technology or law firms
  • Master’s degree in business administration or related field

raw.title: Portfolio Analyst
raw.excerpt: The Patrick J.  McGovern Foundation (PJMF) is a philanthropic organization dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence and data science solutions to create a thriving, equitable, and sustainable future for all.
raw.description:
The Patrick J. McGovern Foundation (PJMF) is a philanthropic organization dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence and data science solutions to create a thriving, equitable, and sustainable future for all. PJMF works in partnership with public, private, and social institutions to drive progress on our most pressing challenges, including digital health, climate change, broad digital access, and data maturity in the social sector.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
Strategic Capital is the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation’s grantmaking function. We fund nonprofits and civil society organizations using data science and AI to advance social good.

Portfolio Analysts help ensure that philanthropic resources are allocated effectively and with impact. They conduct research and analysis to identify and evaluate high-potential grant partners, perform due diligence through desk research, interviews, and financial reviews, and prepare materials to support final grant decisions. Analysts also monitor trends across the data and AI for good ecosystem, distill insights from existing grants, and contribute to learning that informs future investments.
This position reports to the Director of Strategic Capital and offers an opportunity to shape how PJMF deploys capital to accelerate responsible and equitable technology solutions worldwide.


HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:
  • Strategy Development
    • Develop and maintain a working understanding of PJMF’s grantmaking focus areas and the role of data and AI solutions within them.
    • Complete field sensing and landscape analyses that help PJMF stay abreast of new developments, opportunities, and shifts in the fields of AI and data science, and how they can be applied to drive social good.
    • Produce portfolio strategy retrospectives that synthesize outcomes, lessons, and directional insights from grant activity to inform future priorities.
    • Support the generation, validation, and refinement of strategic hypotheses and learning questions that guide PJMF’s philanthropic investments and deepen understanding of the field.
  • Grant Portfolio Development
    • Conduct research and outreach, and lead early-stage conversations, to identify nonprofit and civil society organizations whose work aligns with PJMF’s strategy and may be a fit for grant funding.
    • Prepare clear, evidence-based recommendation materials to support funding decisions.
    • Identify opportunities for collaboration and shared learning across grantees, portfolios, and adjacent fields to enhance collective impact.
  • Team Collaboration
    • Provide flexible, project-based support as we build systems and team practices that enable effective, efficient, and high-impact grantmaking.
    • Summarize learnings from grant reports and external sources into insights that contribute to the Foundation’s broader work in convening and thought leadership.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Experience. 3+ years of relevant work experience in a role requiring rapid learning and sound judgment, such as consulting, business analysis, strategy, or investing. Comfort with data and AI topics is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to get up to speed quickly matter more than any specific sector background.
  • Fast and Nimble Learner. Prepares thoroughly for conversations and brings enough fluency to ask sharp questions without needing to be a subject-matter expert.
  • AI Fluency. Uses AI tools regularly to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis, and brings sound judgment about when to trust, verify, or set aside their outputs. Understands the basics of how these systems work well enough to engage credibly with grantees building or deploying AI.
  • Team-oriented Independence. Pair an ability and desire to work independently with a willingness to check in with leadership and/or teammates on a variable cadence depending on the specifics of a project and its context.
  • Clear Synthesis and Communication. Critically assess how an opportunity aligns with organizational strategy and turns that analysis into a clear, well-reasoned recommendation that identifies open questions and areas for further learning. Communicate outputs from research, analysis, and other activities in a clear, concise, and structured manner.
  • Relationship Management. Be a thoughtful, responsible representative of the Foundation and remain mindful of power dynamics when interacting with external stakeholders. Proactively identify potential issues or roadblocks in external relationships and follow team norms when addressing them.
  • Curiosity. Naturally curious and energized by learning new things, with a habit of following that curiosity wherever it leads.
  • Commitment to Equity. Consistently seek to include the perspectives of underrepresented voices when assessing a potential course of action.

WHAT WE OFFER:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package with a whole person support approach including:

  • Health Insurance: Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, spouses/domestic partners, and dependents. HSA/FSA plans, life insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Long-term Rewards: 401(k) retirement plan with generous matching up to 6% of annual pay, plus an additional discretionary match at the end of the year
  • Time Off: Flexible PTO Policy, 11 paid holidays, paid sick leave, and paid holiday breaks
  • Remote Work Environment: Ability to work 100% remotely, but not alone - with mature, socially minded professionals who care about each other as much as the work, and we connect in person at least once a year to collaborate and create together
  • Wellness Support: Access to Ginger+, Active and Fit Gym membership discount, and SmartSpend Plus, along with financial well-being providers
  • Parental Leave: Up to 6 months of gender-neutral paid leave for parents and caregivers when they have a new addition to their families
  • Learning & Development: Company reimbursement policy, allowing employees to explore development opportunities such as peer learning, internal trainings, and external activities or conferences; savings on student loans (available via insurance provider)
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program: Opportunity for team members to support vulnerable communities, reflecting PJMF’s commitment to social impact
The starting salary range for this position is $100,000 - $115,000 annually. The actual offer may vary depending on factors including the candidate’s relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The Patrick J. McGovern Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

We are seeking an accomplished Senior UI/UX Designer to research, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade digital experiences that support multiple business functions and diverse user groups. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design lifecycle, from translating business requirements into intuitive user experiences and interactive prototypes to developing responsive front-end interfaces, conducting usability testing, and supporting applications throughout their operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in user experience design, visual design, information architecture, and front-end development, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, accessible, and component-driven web applications using modern web technologies. You will work closely with product managers, business analysts, software engineers, QA teams, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality digital products that enhance customer satisfaction and support strategic business objectives.

  • Hands-on production experience creating responsive user interfaces, interactive prototypes, reusable design systems, component libraries, and scalable front-end architectures.
