raw.description:
Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! 🖤

Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui. 😎

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP).Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma culturamassa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo doGreat Place to Work™e em 2025 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a darmatch! 🥰

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

📌Dentro do time de Produto & Tecnologia Astrea, sua missão será:Como Staff Product Designer (UX Especialista) do Astrea, você será a principal referência técnica de design do produto e responderá pela direção de design e usabilidade como parte da estratégia de produto. Sem alocar-se em um squad específico, você vai liderar os projetos mais estratégicos e transversais, como o redesign do produto e a organização e governança do design system, como guardião que garante que ele seja respeitado em todo o produto, conduzindo a execução junto aos designers dos squads e colocando a mão na massa nos momentos críticos. O papel não tem gestão de pessoas: você lidera por critério técnico, influência e exemplo, eleva a qualidade do design por meio de critiques, mentoria e feedback técnico, e atua em parceria com as GPMs, Produto e Engenharia, usando IA para acelerar descoberta, criação e validação.

👉Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga:o modelo de trabalho é 100%Remoto!

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

Direção e estratégia de design

  • Responder pelas decisões estratégicas de design e usabilidade do Astrea, definindo princípios, padrões e diretrizes que orientam todos os squads.
  • Liderar o redesign do produto de ponta a ponta: visão, conceito, arquitetura de informação, padrões de interação e plano de entrega incremental em convivência com as telas legadas.
  • Traduzir a estratégia de produto em direção de design, apresentando racional e trade-offs para diretoria, GPMs, PMs e Engenharia.

Design system

  • Ser guardião(ã) do design system: estratégia, arquitetura de componentes, documentação, governança, roadmap e métricas de adoção.
  • Garantir, junto com Engenharia, que o design system seja implementável em código, com o Figma como fonte da verdade e handoff claro.
  • Incorporar acessibilidade e usabilidade como padrão nos componentes e fluxos.

Liderança de projetos e execução

  • Conduzir a execução dos projetos transversais com os designers dos squads: planejar frentes, distribuir trabalho, revisar entregas e garantir consistência.
  • Atuar hands-on em fluxos, protótipos e UI de alta fidelidade nos pontos mais críticos dos projetos.
  • Conduzir pesquisas, testes de usabilidade e validações qualitativas e quantitativas para embasar as decisões de design.
  • Facilitar workshops, alinhamentos e dinâmicas de ideação e priorização entre squads.

Qualidade e desenvolvimento do time de design

  • Puxar as agendas e cerimônias de design do time, como o critique e design reviews.
  • Mentorar designers no desenvolvimento técnico e apoiar as GPMs com feedbacks técnicos sobre as pessoas designers.
  • Apoiar processos seletivos de design, como avaliação de cases e entrevistas técnicas.

IA no design e no produto

  • Ser referência no uso de IA no processo de design (prototipação em código, geração de variações, síntese de pesquisa) e disseminar boas práticas no time.
  • Definir padrões de experiência para funcionalidades de IA no Astrea, como assistentes e automações nos fluxos do escritório.

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Graduação em Design ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Product Design/UX, com atuação em nível sênior ou acima.
  • Histórico liderando tecnicamente projetos de design (redesign, nova plataforma, design system) em produtos digitais consolidados.
  • Experiência construindo ou evoluindo design systems: tokens, componentes, documentação, governança e adoção.
  • Domínio de UX/UI: arquitetura de informação, design de interação, hierarquia visual, heurísticas de usabilidade e acessibilidade.
  • Vivência com pesquisa e validação (entrevistas, testes de usabilidade, leitura de dados) e decisões orientadas por evidências.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal, com comunicação e apresentação para diferentes níveis, inclusive diretoria.
  • Experiência mentorando designers e conduzindo critiques ou design reviews.
  • Domínio de Figma (componentes, variables, libraries) e de prototipação.
  • Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de design (ex.: Lovable, Replit, Figma AI ou similares).
  • Colaboração próxima com Engenharia e entendimento de como componentes viram código.
  • Portfólio que mostre racional de decisões e impacto, não só telas finais.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Claude Code ou prototipação em código.
  • Redesign de produto em produção, com grande base de usuários e entrega incremental sobre sistema legado.
  • Design de experiências com IA: assistentes, agentes ou interfaces conversacionais.
  • Experiência em SaaS B2B ou produtos verticais; conhecimento do mercado jurídico é um plus.
  • Facilitação de Design Sprint e workshops com stakeholders.

Informações adicionais

E dá uma olhada no que oferecemos às pessoas áureas:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição:R$ 1.300 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Home Office:R$ 135,00 mensais, sem desconto em folha.
  • Plano de Saúde: Bradesco nacional.
  • Plano Odontológico:SulAmérica.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Licenças parentais estendidas: fazemos parte do Programa Empresa Cidadã e oferecemos licenças que apoiam diferentes formatos de família — incluindo adoção, casais homoafetivos e famílias monoparentais.
  • Auxílio Creche:Para filhos(as) até 5 anos de idade.
  • Gympass/Wellhub: plataforma de bem-estar, com foco em atividades físicas e saúde integral. Dá acesso a milhares de academias, estúdios, aulas ao vivo e apps de bem-estar, com apenas uma única mensalidade;
  • Conexa Saúde: plataforma de saúde digital, com diversas especialidades. Com ela, as pessoas áureas têm acesso a 2 consultas psicológicas e 2 consultas nutricionais gratuitas por mês.
  • Guapeco: plano de saúde pet com adesão simples, cobertura nacional e reembolsos de até 100%.
  • Parceria com escola de idiomas:parceria com descontos para os idiomas de inglês e espanhol com a OpenEnglish, Fluentia e Instituto Cervantes, em modalidades online e presenciais.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): se o time bate a meta anual, todo mundo (real!) ganha participação nos lucros!
  • Semana Relax: Não trabalhamos nos dias úteis entre as datas de natal e ano novo, para descansar e aproveitar o final de ano da forma que cada um preferir.
  • Auxílio Posto de Trabalho: além de emprestarmos o notebook, para local de trabalho em sua casa confortável, disponibilizamos um auxílio de R$ 2.400,00.
  • Folga de Aniversários:No mês de seu aniversário você tem um dia inteirinho de day off para descansar e curtir.
  • Trabalhar em um Great Place to Work©: Somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar na América Latina e no Brasil.
  • E muito mais!Com uma cultura de feedback, guildas de desenvolvimento, PDI no onboarding, Aurum Talks, reuniões frequentes com toda a Aurum, transparência em OKR, ações comemorativas, avaliação de desempenho, programas de desenvolvimento entre outros processos que ajudam a desenvolver cada vez mais as pessoas áureas.

E aí, curtiu!? Então vem com a gente :)

At Moodle, we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customizable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organizations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact, and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us. Let's transform education together!

About the Role

Join our team as the Senior Manager, DevOps and become a key leader in delivering cutting-edge technology for our external customers, vendors, and clients. You will manage a fully remote high-performing team dedicated to maintaining and optimizing our critical infrastructure, ensuring peak performance and security. This includes overseeing stability and performance tuning, customer upgrades and migrations, and implementing robust security measures. You will be instrumental in managing the customer support requests and guaranteeing seamless, 24-hour monitoring and support. This is an exciting opportunity to expand the business and make a significant impact on our technology delivery.

Senior Manager, DevOps - Drive Innovation and Infrastructure Excellence (US)

Managing the delivery of technology for external customers, vendors, and other clients to improve and expand the business, the Senior Manager, DevOps is responsible for managing the team maintaining our infrastructure to perform optimally including: maintaining stability of systems, proactive monitoring, servicing customer support requests, removal of technical debt, and being part of a team that pushes our infrastructure forward.

This role will support important security certification projects and work within federal client boundaries. Successful applicants must be US citizens with willingness and ability to receive necessary security clearances.

What You’ll Do

Most days in this role usually involve a mix of:

  • Support DevOps team in managing client hosting infrastructure
  • Lead the team in best practices for deployment, availability, performance and automation

Job Overview

Project Coordinators work under the direction of a project manager to coordinate the logistics of a specific project on a more granular level. They essentially help ensuring that all team members and departments have what they need in order to meet the deadlines and expectations set by the project manager. In order to do this, they must also be familiar with every aspect of the project, pricing, stakeholders, timeline, and budgeting details.

The project coordinator's goal is to help enable the project manager to focus on broader issues and any problems that may arise by managing the day-to-day details of a project. يمكن لمهاراتك في اللغة العربية أن تساهم في تحسين تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي.

المهام

  • تسجيل مقطع فيديو واحد مدته من 15 إلى 20 ثانية باستخدام لهجتك العربية الأصلية.
  • التحدث بشكل طبيعي ومن دون نص مكتوب مسبقًا. يمكنك، على سبيل المثال، التعريف بنفسك باختصار، أو ذكر مكان إقامتك، أو التحدث عن أحد اهتماماتك أو هواياتك.
  • النظر مباشرة إلى الكاميرا طوال مدة التسجيل.
  • بعد التسجيل، الإجابة عن بعض الأسئلة القصيرة عن نفسك، مثل الفئة العمرية، والدولة، واللهجة، لمساعدتنا في تنظيم مجموعة البيانات.

متطلبات التسجيل

يجب استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التالية حتى يتم قبول الفيديو:

  • جودة الفيديو: 1080p أو أعلى.
  • المدة: من 15 إلى 20 ثانية.
  • التصوير: يجب أن يظهر الرأس والكتفان، وأن يكون الوجه في منتصف الصورة وواضحًا بالكامل.
  • الإضاءة والخلفية: يجب أن يكون الوجه مضاءً جيدًا ومن دون ظلال قوية، مع خلفية بسيطة أو محايدة.
  • تعبيرات الوجه: طبيعية وهادئة أثناء التحدث.
  • الصوت: واضح ومن دون ضوضاء في الخلفية أو موسيقى أو صدى.
  • اتجاه التصوير: يمكن التصوير بشكل رأسي أو أفقي، مع تثبيت الكاميرا وتجنب الاهتزاز.
  • مكان التسجيل: يُفضل التسجيل في مكان داخلي هادئ.
  • غير مسموح: استخدام الفلاتر أو أوضاع التجميل، النظارات الشمسية، القبعات أو أغطية الرأس التي تحجب الوجه، أغطية الوجه، سماعات الرأس أو سماعات الأذن، العلامات المائية، الملصقات، الإطارات، أو ظهور أشخاص آخرين أو حيوانات أليفة في الفيديو.

متطلبات المشاركة

  • أن يكون عمرك 18 عامًا أو أكثر.
  • أن تكون متحدثًا أصليًا باللغة العربية وفقًا لتحديدك الذاتي. وقد يُطلب منك إكمال خطوة تحقق قصيرة لتأكيد لهجتك قبل اعتماد مشاركتك بشكل نهائي.

عمل حر

اليمنية، الخليجية، العراقية، والشامية

10 دولارات أمريكية لكل فيديو يتم قبوله

قبل البدء، سيُطلب منك مراجعة نموذج موافقة وقبوله.

يوضح هذا النموذج كيفية استخدام الفيديو والمعلومات التي تقدمها، وكيفية تخزينها، والجهات التي قد تتم مشاركة هذه البيانات معها.

raw.title: Senior Blockchain Engineer
raw.excerpt: About the Jobzerohash is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to help architect and build the infrastructure that powers digital asset transactions across multiple blockchain networks.
raw.description:
About the Job

zerohash is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to help architect and build the infrastructure that powers digital asset transactions across multiple blockchain networks. We are a high-performing team looking for an equally ambitious and driven teammate.

The right candidate for this position is detail-oriented, deeply technical, and driven. You are eager to learn new technologies and complex systems. You build resiliency and scalability into the platform at every step.

If you're looking to have a massive impact in one of the most exciting markets in decades, you will find this role challenging and rewarding in equal measure

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build blockchain integration services — transaction signing, deposit processing, and confirmation tracking — across multiple networks (EVM, Solana, Polkadot, XRP, and others)
  • Build and maintain gRPC microservices in Go within an event-driven architecture using NATS JetStream
  • Implement transaction state machines with reliability guarantees including idempotency, distributed locking, and chain reorganization handling
  • Integrate with custody providers for secure transaction signing and wallet management
  • Monitor blockchain networks for deposits, confirmations, and anomalies
  • Participate in on-call rotation, responding to production incidents across blockchain infrastructure
  • When necessary, communicate directly with client technical teams

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, preferably in the FinTech space
  • Deep proficiency with Go
  • Understanding of blockchain technologies, protocols, and their applications
  • Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers
  • Familiarity with message brokers or event streaming systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar)
  • Experience with MongoDB or other document databases
  • Understanding of SQL and relational database schema design
  • A humble and scrappy get-it-done mindset; you're resourceful and in your element going from 0 to 1
  • Excellent problem solving skills — can troubleshoot complex distributed systems
  • Comfort with ambiguity; the ability to independently lay out and test clear hypotheses and solve problems without well-defined direction
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred

  • Bachelor's in computer science or equivalent experience
  • Experience at a banking-as-a-service, brokerage-as-a-service, or payment-as-a-service business
  • Experience with digital assets or centralized exchanges
  • Experience integrating with blockchain custody platforms (Fireblocks, BitGo, or similar)
  • Experience with distributed systems patterns (distributed locking, idempotency, state machines, CQRS)
  • Experience with smart contracts
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you're interested in.

Sevita provides community-based services for Treatment Foster Care. Here we believe every person has the right to live well, and everyone deserves to have a fulfilling career. You’ll join a mission-driven team and create relationships that motivate us all every day. Join us today, and experience a career well lived.

OUR MISSION AND PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Sevita is a mission-based organization dedicated to providing high quality services to those we serve. Therefore, to deliver on our mission, The Network expects every employee to perform his or her job first and foremost in accordance with the Company’s mission.

SUMMARY

Designs, creates, and delivers marketing collateral and programs to support expansion and growth of the company services. Creates presentations and provides reports according to the information gathered such as new services, market trends, competition, and pricing. Familiar with a wide range of the field’s practices, concepts, and procedures.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below:

  • Participates in the creation of annual marketing/communications strategy for state operations. Works with state-based operations to create and implement specialized marketing plans to support core growth opportunities.
  • Participates in corporate marketing and branding efforts including drafting content for collateral materials and overseeing design process.
  • Participates in the design and implementation of marketing trainings for field staff.
  • Assists in maintaining company branding/image standards. Facilitates re-branding activities for acquisitions.
  • Coordinates development of state websites and serves as troubleshooter for state web efforts.
  • Manages marketing materials on company intranet.
  • Creates customized collateral materials to support state specific service lines, audiences and geographies; core growth initiatives; foster parent and host home provider recruitment; online marketing material fulfillment system programs; conference participation.
  • Serves as consultant to state-based operations in the creation and use of collateral materials.
  • Manages online marketing material fulfillment system.Develop e-fliers, postcards and other materials as needed to support conference participation.
  • Provides marketing/communications support for video projects as needed.
  • Performs other related duties and activities as required.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing or related field
  • Two years' experience creating email campaigns
  • Experience working in healthcare, social services, or related field
  • Strong communication / customer service skills
  • Experience with Hubspot a plus

Help make a difference in the lives of others--apply today!

Sevita is a leading provider of home and community-based specialized health care. We believe that everyone deserves to live a full, more independent life. We provide people with quality services and individualized supports that lead to growth and independence, regardless of the physical, intellectual, or behavioral challenges they face.

We’ve made this our mission for more than 50 years. And today, our 40,000 team members continue to innovate and enhance care for the 50,000 individuals we serve all over the U.S.

As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Account Executive, New Business

GEORGIA-BASED ROLE | B2B SOFTWARE SALES | FULL-CYCLE OWNERSHIP

About Rhythm

Rhythm builds the technology backbone for trade and professional associations. Our platform supports membership and dues, certifications and continuing education, events, financial operations, and more. When an association selects a new management system, it is making a decision that shapes how the organization operates for years.

We're developing the next generation of Rhythm: a modern, AI-first platform designed to serve associations of different sizes and complexities. We're looking for a proven Account Executive to help us take that vision to market.

The Opportunity

You'll own new business sales from first conversation to signed contract. This is a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale, not a high-volume dialing role. You'll report directly to the founder, work closely with a Solutions Engineer, and have meaningful input into how we position, sell, and improve the product.

What You Will Own

  • Full-cycle sales. Qualify, discover, demonstrate, propose, negotiate, and close complex opportunities.
  • Thoughtful discovery. Understand how prospects run membership, education, events, and financial workflows, then connect their needs to a credible solution.
  • Tailored demos. Partner with a Solutions Engineer to demonstrate the workflows that matter to each buying team.
  • Multi-threaded deals. Build relationships with executives, department leaders, finance, IT advisors, and boards. Navigate RFPs and formal evaluations when needed.
  • Commercial ownership. Build proposals, manage pricing conversations, negotiate terms, and maintain a realistic forecast.
  • Strong handoffs. Document promises, requirements, and context so the implementation team can deliver successfully.
  • CRM discipline and feedback. Keep HubSpot current with real next steps, stakeholders, close dates, and competitive insights. Help us learn from every win and loss.

What a Typical Deal Looks Like

Annual software value typically ranges from $15,000 to $80,000, with implementation projects often ranging from $15,000 to $40,000. Sales cycles generally last 3 to 8 months and involve multiple decision-makers. You may manage 25 to 30 active opportunities at once. Buyers often include executive directors, CEOs, membership and education leaders, finance teams, and board members.

What You Must Bring

  • At least 5 years selling B2B software or SaaS, including direct responsibility for closing deals and carrying a quota.
  • Experience with sales cycles of 3 months or longer, where meaningful discovery, follow-up, and consensus-building are required.
  • Proven multi-stakeholder or enterprise-style selling, including presentations to buying committees and executive decision-makers, not just individual buyers.
  • A track record of quota attainment and examples of complex deals you have personally advanced and closed.
  • Confident discovery, negotiation, and pipeline management, with reliable CRM habits and strong written communication.
  • Georgia residency. This position is open to candidates currently based in Georgia.

Helpful, But Not Required

  • Experience with associations, professional societies, nonprofits, or member-based organizations.
  • Familiarity with AMS, LMS, event technology, fundraising, or related software.
  • Experience with formal RFPs, data migrations, integrations, and implementation-dependent sales.

Why Rhythm

Real ownership, direct access to leadership, and a product with meaningful impact. You will join a small, experienced team where your work is visible and your feedback can influence our roadmap and go-to-market approach. We value honest forecasting, curiosity, strong execution, and results over activity for its own sake.

How We Work

HubSpot for CRM; Zoom for demos; Fellow for meeting notes; Guru for internal knowledge; and Google Workspace for collaboration. You will work with a Solutions Engineer on demos and our professional services team on customer handoffs.

Interested? If you enjoy complex software sales, value autonomy, and want to help grow a next-generation platform, we would like to hear from you. Apply to join Rhythm Software.

raw.description:
The Access Security team is building the intelligence layer for the ServiceNow Veza Identity solution, helping enterprises answer one of the most important security questions: who and what can access critical resources? We turn complex identity and access data into clear, actionable insights so customers can uncover risky access, prioritize remediation, and reduce exposure before issues become incidents.

We are looking for a seasoned Sr Staff Backend Engineer to architect, design, develop, optimize, and maintain Access Security features that use AI to improve access intelligence, risk detection, and remediation workflows. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build secure, scalable backend services and AI-assisted workflows that can operate reliably in enterprise environments. This role requires expertise in Go and Python, practical AI integration experience, and leadership in architecting high-performance services.

What you’ll do: 

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to craft solutions that balance innovation, performance, and business impact.
  • Champion the responsible use of LLM frameworks, AI agents, and AI-driven access intelligence to deliver enterprise-ready capabilities for identity and access use cases.
  • Explore emerging technologies and patterns in identity and access management that help us deliver greater customer value while improving solution resilience, scalability, and performance.
  • Participate in all technical aspects of team deliverables, including architecture, design, quality, performance, maintainability, and code reviews.
  • Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases. 
  • Mentor and guide other engineers by sharing engineering practices, raising quality standards, and fostering continuous improvement in testing, reliability, and production readiness.
  • Own end-to-end feature delivery, steering capabilities from early design and architecture to release, operational oversight, and ongoing stability.
  • Applied AI experience: Practical experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into production workflows, such as decision support, risk analysis, automation, or security-focused access intelligence.
  • Experience: 10+ years in backend software development, with deep technical hands-on experience building complex Enterprise production software.
  • Languages & Architecture: Strong proficiency in Golang and other key programming languages (e.g., Python or Java), with a strong architectural vision.
  • Data and APIs: Expertise designing and implementing RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs, with strong proficiency in data modeling, SQL, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and graph technologies such as Neo4j.
  • Systems Engineering: Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Leadership: Proven track record of leading major, cross-functional technical projects from conception to launch.
  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Soft Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), IGA, and PAM solutions.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Artificial Intelligence: Hands-on familiarity building with cutting-edge LLM frameworks and provider libraries like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google.
  • Quality & Testing: Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Mindset: Strong sense of ownership and customer focus, with a passion for user experience and staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $171,900 - $300,800, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

From Fortune. ©2026 Fortune Media IP Limited. All rights reserved. Used under license.

Veza is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources—providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

Company Overview:

Lehrer Family Chiropractic is a leading chiropractic clinic located in Melville, New York. Our team of experienced chiropractors and healthcare professionals are dedicated to providing exceptional care to our patients. We are currently seeking a Remote Medical Scribe to join our team and assist our doctors with documenting patient visits.

Position Overview:

The Remote Medical Scribe will work closely with our chiropractors to accurately and efficiently document patient visits. This is a part-time, remote position, allowing for a flexible work schedule.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Use electronic medical record (EMR) software to document patient visits in real-time
  • Accurately transcribe physician-patient interactions, including medical history, physical exams, and treatment plans
  • Ensure all documentation is complete and accurate, following clinic guidelines and standards

  • Previous experience as a medical scribe or in a healthcare setting preferred
  • Familiarity with medical terminology and EMR software

- Excellent typing and computer skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA regulations

Contract Details:

This is a part-time, remote position with a flexible work schedule. The Remote Medical Scribe will be required to work approximately 20 hours per week. Compensation will be based on experience.

Join Our Team:

If you are a detail-oriented individual with a passion for healthcare and strong communication skills, we want to hear from you! As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work with experienced healthcare professionals and make a positive impact on the lives of our patients. Apply today to join our growing team at Lehrer Family Chiropractic.

This is a paid freelance, remote position.

Polygon is a leading entertainment and gaming publication, delivering timely news, insightful commentary, and original coverage across video games, movies, television, comics, and pop culture.

As a recognized voice in entertainment journalism, Polygon operates in a fast-paced digital publishing environment and is always looking for experienced, passionate contributors who can produce original, engaging, and high-quality content.

We're looking for passionate and knowledgeable freelance books writers who can create timely, engaging content around the biggest books, authors, literary trends, publishing news, adaptations, and conversations shaping the reading community. This role goes beyond writing articles—it's about connecting with a dedicated audience of readers and entertainment fans through insightful, high-performing content.

Your Responsibilities

  • Monitor book industry news, literary trends, bestseller lists, social media conversations, and adaptation announcements to identify timely content opportunities
  • Write engaging features, mini-features, lists, rankings, recommendations, and opinion pieces related to books and literary culture
  • Cover topics ranging from bestselling novels and emerging authors to book-to-screen adaptations, publishing trends, and reader communities
  • Work closely with editors to develop compelling content ideas and execute editorial priorities
  • Comfortable working independently while consistently meeting deadlines
  • Ensure timely publication of relevant content aligned with SEO and audience engagement goals
  • Follow editorial and formatting guidelines rigorously

What We Offer

  • Fully remote — write from wherever you’d like!
  • Opportunities to pitch original ideas
  • An amazing community of like-minded people to nerd-out with on a daily basis

Experience and Skills

  • At least 2 years experience in digital journalism or online publishing
  • Ability to independently write and publish clean, accurate content on tight deadlines
  • Strong understanding of gaming culture, internet trends, memes, and online communities
  • Passion for video games, entertainment, and digital storytelling
  • Familiarity with SEO and CMS tools

How to Apply

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV
  • A sample article similar in nature to the content published on Polygon.

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process.



Polygon is part of the Valnet Publishing Group.

Valnet, founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Role overview

Netwrix is growing its footprint across Northern Europe, and we need a sales leader who can turn that ambition into pipeline, partnerships, and revenue. As Sales Director, Northern Europe, you'll own the region's go-to-market execution — building a strong direct and channel motion, developing enterprise relationships, and giving our sales, product, and marketing teams the on-the-ground insight they need to win.

You'll report to the VP of EMEA Sales and will have direct responsibility for the sales team, currently composed of 4 Account Executives (AEs), and you will have access to a matrixed support organization including Channel, Pre-Sales, and Marketing teams.

We are looking for a hard-working, hands-on manager with a strong entrepreneurial mindset. The objective is to rebuild the region and restore it to the position it deserves within EMEA, while delivering growth in line with the overall EMEA business: namely, sustained double-digit growth.

Key Responsibilities

Sales leadership & strategy

  • Develop and execute the Northern Europe sales strategy (UK + Nordics), aligned with global revenue goals.
  • Lead and manage a team of account executives, and in matrix , CAM and pre-sales engineers.
  • Forecast, track, and report on sales performance metrics and regional KPIs.
  • Expand Netwrix's customer base across Northern Europe through strategic planning and effective pipeline management.

Business development & customer engagement

  • Drive new business development in enterprise and public-sector accounts across Northern Europe.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, influencers, and C-level stakeholders.
  • Represent Netwrix as a senior spokesperson at regional events, conferences, and industry engagements.

Channel & partner ecosystem

  • Expand and optimize the partner network, including distributors, VARs, and system integrators.
  • Partner with the Channel Director to define and implement effective partner programs.
  • Ensure partners are well-equipped to deliver value-added Netwrix solutions to end customers.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing, product management, support, and customer success teams to align on regional goals.
  • Share market feedback and customer insights to help shape product roadmap and strategic direction.

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise software solution sales experience, including sales leadership.
  • Cybersecurity industry experience.
  • Proven track record of sales leadership and strategy execution.
  • Your creativity, your ability to unite and inspire a team, and your capacity to articulate and execute a compelling vision.
  • Your exceptional operational excellence and willingness to stay constantly engaged in the field alongside your teams.
  • our extensive knowledge of both Enterprise and SMB sales, with a proven ability to navigate and close opportunities across the full spectrum of the market.

We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behavior — from how fans spend their money and the events they attend to the content they consume and the channels they engage with. We turn these insights into strategies and solutions that help our clients grow their audiences and drive both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenue.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 900 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, Visa, the NFL, Nike, and Amazon. With nearly 1,000 people across 14 offices, we partner with sports and entertainment organizations of all shapes and sizes around the world.

The Opportunity

We're always looking to connect with talented freelance professionals who are passionate about sports, entertainment, and delivering impactful work.

As our business continues to grow, we're building a network of freelancers who can bring specialized expertise, fresh perspectives, and hands-on support to a variety of client and internal projects across our global business.

Opportunities may span a range of disciplines, including:

  • Commercial Strategy & Consulting: Commercial strategy, sponsorship, partnerships, business development, revenue growth, and strategic advisory.
  • Fan Research & Insights: Fan research, audience segmentation, consumer behavior, market research, survey design and execution, data collection, and insights development.
  • Marketing & Paid Media: Paid media strategy, media planning and buying, digital marketing, campaign execution, audience targeting, and performance optimization.
  • Creative & Content: Graphic design, video production, editing, social media, creative development, and content production.
  • Data & Analytics: Business intelligence, data analysis, performance measurement, reporting, and data visualization.
  • Technology & Product: Product management, software development, data engineering, and technical delivery.
  • Project Management & Operations: Project coordination, operational support, process improvement, and specialist project delivery.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in connecting with proactive, collaborative professionals who bring expertise in their respective fields and can hit the ground running.

Depending on the opportunity, we're looking for individuals who can:

  • Bring relevant experience and specialized skills to support client and internal projects.
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted partner, communicating effectively with stakeholders, and ensuring projects are delivered in line with client expectations and business objectives.
  • Manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver high-quality work.
  • Take ownership of their responsibilities and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Bring fresh ideas, creative thinking, and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Adapt to different project scopes, timelines, and client needs.

Experience within the sports and entertainment industry is a plus, but not required for every opportunity.

Engagement Details

Freelance opportunities will vary based on business and client needs. Engagements may be short-term, long-term, part-time, or project-based, with specific responsibilities, timelines, and working arrangements determined by each opportunity.

We welcome interest from freelancers across different experience levels and specializations, whether your expertise lies in strategic consulting, research and analytics, marketing, creative execution, technology, or operational support.

Interested in Working With Us?

Whether you're an established freelancer or exploring new opportunities to apply your skills, we'd love to hear from you!

Submit your resume, portfolio (if applicable), and details of your areas of expertise to be considered for current and future freelance opportunities with Two Circles.

Please note: This is a general freelance talent pool posting rather than an opening for one specific position. Our team will reach out if an opportunity arises that aligns with your background, skills, and availability.

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

POSITION SUMMARY: With general direction, utilizing an understanding of accounting principles, the Area Accountant performs accounting activities to record, analyze and monitor financial information. The incumbent prepares financial reports in a manner that ensures accuracy and compliance with company accounting policies. The Area Accountant may act as a resource for accounting and general administrative staff and is responsible for a broad array of accounting duties.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information to prepare journal entries and document business transactions. Prepares monthly and quarterly operational performance reports. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Assists the Area Controller in ensuring there are proper internal controls in place including compliance with company policies and procedures, Sarbanes Oxley and all other statutory requirements. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Reconciles balance sheet accounts and statistical data and fully analyses financial statements in accordance with the Generally Accepted Accounting Principals (GAAP) and Company policy.

  • May assist the Area Controller in the management of accounting personnel. May provide direction to the different accounting functional areas (invoice processing, billing, cash receipts, work order processing, credit analysis, receivable collections, month-end close, journal entries, statistical data, and payroll).

  • Supports the Area Controller during the annual budget and interim forecasting process and assists with analytical review.

  • Supports the accounting aspects of capital expenditures, transfers and retirements.

  • Assists with periodic financial audits including internal audits, external audits and peer reviews.

  • Provides support and responds to information requests from corporate (accounting, tax, treasury, IT, HR, sales, environmental compliance, legal, etc.) as well as region and area field financial management as required.

  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Accounting experience.

  • A thorough knowledge and understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principals (GAAP).

  • Have MS Excel skills at an intermediate level.

  • Must be able to demonstrate initiative to thoughtfully and fully research and follow up on non-standard situations to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

  • Effective and professional interpersonal communication across various levels of the organization and with external customers and vendors.

  • Strong analytical skills.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Architect, you’ll be a strategic advisor to some of GitLab’s most important customers, helping them connect our DevSecOps platform to their business goals and realize meaningful, long-term outcomes. You’ll partner closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into concrete success plans, guide them along the customer journey, and drive hands-on enablement, adoption, utilization, and maturity. Reporting into a Senior Manager within our North America Customer Success organization, you’ll own a book of customers, act as their primary GitLab liaison for questions and escalations, and coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support so customers can navigate complex technical and organizational challenges with confidence.

You’ll use your understanding of Git, software development lifecycles, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices to help customers adopt best practices and stay current with new GitLab capabilities. In your first year, success looks like building strong, consultative relationships with key stakeholders, increasing adoption of the GitLab platform, and strengthening retention, growth, and customer satisfaction across your portfolio.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with customers to translate pre-sales command plans and desired business outcomes into actionable objectives and clear success criteria.
  • Guide customers on how to best use the GitLab platform, including common DevSecOps best practices, Git workflows, CI/CD, and adoption patterns.
  • Own a book of customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic and technical engagement.
  • Build and maintain Customer Success Plans, define critical goals and key performance indicators, and track progress with customers over time.
  • Act as the primary GitLab liaison for assigned accounts, coordinating responses to questions, issues, and escalations across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.
  • Provide hands-on technical enablement and onboarding, including education on new GitLab features, releases, and relevant use cases.
  • Program manage account escalations, ensuring root causes are understood, follow-up actions are owned, and stakeholders are informed.
  • Collaborate with Services and other internal teams to identify and recommend training, enablement, and maturity opportunities aligned to customer needs.

What you’ll bring

  • Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and modern software development lifecycles.
  • Working knowledge of continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience partnering with customers to define business outcomes and translate them into actionable success plans, key goals, and measures.
  • Background in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles focused on adoption, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of customers, including handling escalations and coordinating across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Experience planning and managing projects or initiatives in technical environments, including identifying training and enablement needs.
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in applying transferable skills from related roles or industries, with flexibility to travel as needed according to company policy.

About the team

We are part of GitLab’s Customer Success organization. Our mission is to help customers align the GitLab platform with their business objectives through hands-on technical enablement, driving adoption, utilization, and DevSecOps maturity while building strong, consultative relationships. As Customer Success Architects, we act as trusted advisors and key liaisons between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem, collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to address questions, guide roadmaps, and navigate escalations. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous way, coordinating across time zones to support a focused set of strategic accounts and ensure long-term customer success.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

Nift is disrupting performance marketing, delivering millions of new customers to brands every month. We’re actively looking for a Staff Accountant to join our Finance team.

In this role, you will support Nift’s accounting operations by owning day-to-day transaction processing and contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and assisting in audit preparation. You’ll report directly to and work closely with our Senior Accountant to bring all of the accounting functions in-house, ensure accurate financial reporting is done in a concise timeframe, prepare for and support our continued growth.

Our Mission

Nift’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.

Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.

What you will do:

  • Own day-to-day accounting operations, including processing and posting all accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions
  • Review and approve AP/AR entries for accuracy and completeness prior to management review
  • Prepare and post month-end close journal entries, including accruals and partner reconciliations
  • Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations and support variance and flux analysis
  • Support the monthly close process by ensuring timely approvals, accurate documentation, and clean financial data
  • Assist with audit preparation by maintaining organized records and responding to auditor requests
  • Partner closely with the Senior Accountant and broader Finance team to follow established workflows, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve processes
  • Support the transition of our core accounting functions from outside accounting firm to inhouse and help build scalable internal accounting operations

What you need:

  • A minimum of 3+ years of general accounting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • Proven experience in a variety of core accounting principles, journal entries and month-end close processes
  • Experience in a private company environment is required or have transitioned from public to private accounting for at least one year
  • Ownership Mindset: Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of initiative, consistently taking responsibility, and exceeds expectations
  • High attention to detail, has capacity to get stuff done, and stay organized

What you get:

  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits (401(k) with matching, Medical/Dental/Vision), and we offer full-time employees the potential to hold company equity
  • Flexible remote work
  • Unlimited Responsible PTO
  • Great opportunity to join a growing, cash-flow-positive company while having a direct impact on Nift's revenue, growth, scale, and future success

raw.description:
Men in Blazers is the No. 1 Soccer Media Network in the U.S. With a wide reach and a diverse, vocal fan base, we engage with teams, players, celebrity fans, and brands we love, to share our passion for soccer across the nation. Using humor, emotion, intelligence, and to-the-minute pop cultural aptitude, we provide fans with unique content that breaks down the biggest stories in the game in ways that are authentic, meaningful, and compulsively entertaining.

We are looking for a Director of Football Trips and Experiences to lead Men in Blazers’ football trips business from concept through launch and delivery. In this role, you will create experiences that combine live football with local culture, distinctive access, and the community that makes Men in Blazers special. You will own the trip portfolio, customer proposition, pricing recommendations, budget, sales targets, and guest experience, working closely with our travel partner. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with direct experience developing and selling travel or sports experience products. You should be comfortable forming recommendations, making decisions with incomplete information, and taking responsibility for the results. Experience building a new offering within a media company, community brand, or growing travel business is particularly valuable.

Director of Football Trips and Experiences

Location: United States, Remote

What you’ll do:

  • Oversee the end-to-end strategy and launch for Men in Blazers Football Trips and Experiences.
  • Develop a high-demand calendar of football travel experiences and itineraries combining match access, local culture, and entertainment for US fans.
  • Continuously validate target customer segments and refine product offerings based on market research and performance feedback.
  • Manage overall commercial targets, trip budgets, revenue forecasts, package pricing, and profitability margins.
  • Establish operational thresholds for trip go/no-go decisions, sales deadlines, group sizes, and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead partner and supplier relationships across clubs, venues, and operators to secure unique access and confirm delivery of inclusions.
  • Manage end-to-end guest communications, trip execution, disruption contingency planning, and on-site host support.
  • Drive commercial launch strategies alongside internal marketing, sales, content, and talent teams to maximize reach and conversion.
  • Align annual operational plans and key financial parameters with leadership while retaining autonomous decision-making authority.
  • Establish a commercially viable trip portfolio launched on schedule with hit booking, revenue, and profitability targets.
  • Cultivate high guest satisfaction leading to repeat bookings and a sustainable, scalable operational model.

What you need:

  • 7+ years of experience in developing, launching, and selling consumer travel products, hosted group trips, sports hospitality, and/or premium fan experiences.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience overseeing cross-functional internal teams and external partners while remaining hands-on day to day.
  • Ability to manage multiple team members and partners across the country, especially during non-traditional work hours (evenings and weekends)
  • A track record of owning commercial outcomes, including pricing, budgets, revenue, and contribution margin.
  • Practical experience with itineraries, ticket access, accommodation, transport, supplier relationships, and guest service.
  • Experience working with a third party travel operator or specialist fulfillment partner.
  • Sound commercial judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs, negotiate effectively, and act decisively.
  • Deep understanding of the American soccer community, what inspires them to travel abroad, and how to capture their imagination.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex plans into clear customer information and actionable recommendations.
  • Willingness to travel internationally and work selected evenings and weekends around trips and experiences.

Men In Blazers LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $120,000 - $150,000

raw.description:
Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. Impulsionamos a transformação digital de grandes empresas, habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis para que nossos clientes possam oferecer melhores produtos e experiências digitais.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É ter espaço para contribuir com diferentes perspectivas, aprender, experimentar e construir junto.

Acreditamos que times diversos ampliam a forma como pensamos, criamos e entregamos. Por isso, esta oportunidade faz parte do nosso compromisso de ampliar a representatividade de Pessoas com Deficiência na Sensedia e construir experiências cada vez mais inclusivas.

Nos comprometemos com um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso e, durante o processo seletivo, queremos entender também quais condições podemos oferecer para proporcionar a melhor experiência para cada pessoa.

Conheça mais sobre a Sensedia em: Sensedia Careers

Qual a missão do cargo?

Garantir a qualidade da entrega do produto da melhor maneira possível e ao mesmo tempo desenvolver, manter e evoluir os nossos processos de Qualidade com foco em Testes de APIs e microserviços.

Quais serão suas atividades no dia a dia?

  • Implantar e disseminar a cultura de qualidade para o time e dentro de projetos correlacionados.
  • Criar um relacionamento de parceria junto a área de desenvolvimento para que haja alinhamento para a criação e evolução do projeto / produto.
  • Executar os testes funcionais manuais e automatizados, com objetivo de garantir a qualidade da entrega (código / produto / processo). Avaliar e mitigar possíveis bugs (código / produto / produção) que possam aparecer durante o desenvolvimento do projeto / produto.
  • Compreender a demanda e regras de negócio para garantir a qualidade da entrega e alinhamento entre projetos /produtos. Participar ativamente dos ritos ágeis do time.
  • Executar testes exploratórios e integrados, a partir dos requisitos definidos pelo cliente (interno / externo).
  • Compreender design e padrões de API para executar os testes atendendo às diversas demandas do projeto / produto.
  • Realizar reuniões junto ao cliente para alinhamento de demandas.
  • Identificar novas ferramentas e inovações que sejam adequadas para o projeto / produto, considerando as particularidades do contexto em que estiver inserido.
  • Criar e aprimorar documentos que facilitem a utilização do produto para o usuário a partir de orientações recebidas dos líderes e arquitetos.
  • Realizar o levantamento de cenários de testes, identificando fluxos básicos e alternativos.
  • Preparar massa de dados para execução de cenários de testes.
  • Colaborar na coleta de dados para criação de métricas e gerar estimativas para entregar ao cliente.
  • Preparar o ambiente de teste para iniciar os testes seguindo as demandas.
  • Aplicar os conceitos de testes adequados para garantir a qualidade da entrega.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para este cargo?

  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes android como: Appium, Robot Framework, Roboeletric, JUnit, Mockk, Espresso e UI Automator;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes para backend como: Postman e Newman;
  • Ferramentas utilizadas pela companhia: Jira, Git, Zephyr Scale, RabbitMQ e Openshift;
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD como: Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines ou Gitlab;
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com testes em Microserviços e filas de processamentos como o RabbitMQ;
  • Experiência em versionamento com Git;
  • Experiência em banco de dados (SQL, NoSQL);
  • Ter atuado em times ágeis;
  • Ter visão de todo o ciclo de entrega da solução e propor melhorias;
  • Conhecimentos em APIs RESTful e GraphQL;
  • Forte senso de análise crítica e validação de problemas na aplicação e consulta de logs para extração e abertura de bugs para equipe de desenvolvimento.

Quais são os diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência com automação de testes, em alguma linguagem de programação, como: Javascript, Java ou NodeJS;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de automação de testes como: Cucumber, JUnit, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, JMeter.

Sobre esta oportunidade

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

Sabemos que cada pessoa possui experiências e necessidades diferentes. Por isso, durante a candidatura, teremos algumas perguntas para conhecer melhor você e entender se existe alguma adaptação ou recurso de acessibilidade que possamos oferecer durante o processo seletivo.

Caso precise de alguma adaptação — como recursos de acessibilidade, adequação de uma etapa, apoio de comunicação ou outra necessidade — queremos saber. Nosso time de Talent Acquisition estará disponível para conversar com você.

A necessidade de adaptação não interfere na avaliação das suas competências para a posição.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação — Cartão Flash;
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PPR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Programa Well-Being, destinado à saúde física e mental;
  • Universidade Corporativa — #SensediaAcademy;
  • Parceiros culturais e educacionais com descontos especiais;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.

Temos o #WorkWhereYouBelong como nossa proposta de valor para um modelo flexível de trabalho. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores e queremos que exista uma só Sensedia, independentemente de onde você esteja.

Queremos conhecer você!

Se você se identifica com a oportunidade, candidate-se mesmo que não preencha 100% dos requisitos.

Queremos conhecer sua trajetória, suas experiências e o que você pode construir com a gente.

Durante a candidatura, poderemos solicitar informações relacionadas à deficiência e às necessidades de acessibilidade para viabilizar a participação na oportunidade afirmativa e proporcionar uma experiência adequada durante o processo. Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados — Lei nº 13.709/2018.
