This is a remote position.

We are seeking a seasoned, forward-thinking Senior Project Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead critical, high-impact technology projects. The ideal candidate will be the driving force behind our complex system and data integration initiatives, ensuring seamless connectivity between disparate enterprise systems, APIs, cloud environments, and third-party platforms.
As a leader, you must possess a deep understanding of the latest technology trends (Cloud, Microservices, AI/ML integrations, DevOps), be an expert in project management tools like Atlassian Jira, and exhibit exceptional communication skills to align cross-functional tech teams with executive stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
  • Integration Delivery Management: End-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex software and system integration projects (e.g., API-led connectivity, legacy-to-cloud migrations, ERP/CRM integrations, and third-party ecosystem rollouts).
  • Agile Governance & Tooling: Establish robust project tracking mechanisms. Act as the administrator/expert for Jira and Confluence, managing sprints, backlogs, velocity charts, burndown metrics, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Tech-Driven Leadership: Keep pace with modern tech frameworks. Facilitate deep-dive technical discussions around microservices architecture, middleware (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Kafka), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Act as the primary bridge between engineering teams, QA, product owners, vendor partners, and C-level executives. Translate technical complexities into business-friendly progress updates.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify integration bottlenecks, architectural dependencies, data security risks, and scope creep. Formulate decisive mitigation plans to keep delivery timelines on track.
  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, inspire, and mentor distributed, cross-functional engineering teams in India and globally, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Experience: 15+ years of core project management experience within the IT, software development, or global consulting sectors, with a proven track record of delivering multi-million dollar projects.
  • Integration Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of integration intricacies, including data synchronization, security protocols (OAuth, SSL), error handling, latency optimization, and middleware routing.
  • Tools Proficiency: Advanced expertise in Jira, Jira Align, or MS Project for tracking complex software delivery workflows.
  • Tech Savviness: Strong conceptual understanding of modern software paradigms—CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native application architectures.
  • Communication: Flawless verbal and written English communication skills. The ability to command respect, negotiate timelines, and resolve conflicts across global teams is non-negotiable.
  • Certifications (Preferred): PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certifications are highly desirable.

We nurture a culture that embraces all individuals and promotes diverse perspectives, where you can make an impact and grow your career. Exavalu also promotes flexibility depending on the needs of employees, customers and the business. It might be part-time work, working outside normal 9-5 business hours or working remotely.. About Puppy Sphere:

Welcome to Puppy Sphere! We’re a high-growth startup redefining the wellness category through the gentle power of puppy therapy. 🐶

As North America’s most loved puppy yoga company, we’re on a mission to bring people together through experiences that help them slow down, boost their mood, and make wellness a ritual worth coming back to.

We’ve welcomed over 450,000 guests across our 13 studios in the U.S. and Canada, built a community of over 400,000 people, and partnered with global brands including the NBA, TikTok, and Google to bring puppy therapy to workplaces, events, and communities.

We’re rapidly opening new studios and looking for passionate, ambitious people to grow with us.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, care deeply about people, and love raising the bar in everything you do, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Description:

We're looking for a Head of Customer Experience to turn first-time guests into lifelong Puppy Sphere customers.

This is a role with direct ownership of customer satisfaction, retention, loyalty, memberships, and repeat revenue across our North American locations.

You'll lead our Customer Experience team while building the strategies, systems, and programs that keep customers coming back. From exceptional customer service to membership growth, revenue-generating customer interactions, and innovative loyalty initiatives, you'll play a meaningful role in how we scale.

We're looking for someone who thinks like a business owner, loves both people and numbers, and knows how to turn great customer experiences into measurable growth.

This is not just about keeping customers happy. It's about giving them every reason to come back.

Compensation:

  • Total OTE: $80,500–$92,000 CAD
    • Base Salary: $70,000–$80,000 CAD
    • Performance-based bonus: up to 15% of base

Job Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Customer Experience team.
  • Own customer service performance, including response times, resolution rates, satisfaction, and service recovery.
  • Build scalable processes, service standards, training programs, and a centralized knowledge base across our locations.
  • Improve customer accessibility through channels such as texting, live chat, email, and phone support.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology, automation, and AI while maintaining a personal touch.

Customer Journey & Experience Improvement

  • Own the customer feedback ecosystem, including surveys, reviews, and satisfaction tracking.
  • Oversee Google Business Profiles, review management, and customer reputation.
  • Analyze customer behaviour and feedback to identify friction points and opportunities.
  • Partner with Studio Operations to improve the end-to-end guest journey.
  • Turn customer insights into actionable improvements that increase satisfaction and loyalty.

Customer Retention & Revenue Growth

  • Own strategies to increase repeat bookings, purchase frequency, customer lifetime value, and revenue from our existing customer base.
  • Drive growth and performance of memberships and class packs, including conversions, onboarding, renewals, engagement, and churn reduction.
  • Develop loyalty, referral, rebooking, and win-back programs that encourage repeat visits and increase customer spend.
  • Partner with Marketing to execute high-performing retention campaigns, personalized offers, and lifecycle communications.
  • Leverage customer data and segmentation to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Identify opportunities to generate incremental revenue through customer service interactions, including bookings, membership upgrades, and qualified private event leads.
  • Develop sales incentives and performance targets that motivate the CX team to drive revenue while delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Continuously test and optimize initiatives, scaling what works.
  • Set clear retention and revenue targets, track performance, and take accountability for measurable improvements.

Analytics, Reporting & Performance

  • Own reporting and performance tracking for customer satisfaction, retention, memberships, customer service sales, and repeat revenue.
  • Develop clear dashboards and regular performance updates.
  • Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and share actionable insights with Marketing and Operations.
  • Identify trends, measure program ROI, and prioritize initiatives with the greatest business impact.
  • Translate insights into action and hold yourself and your team accountable for results.

Job Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in customer experience, retention, loyalty, customer success, or a related field.
  • Previous experience managing or coaching a customer-facing team.
  • Experience developing customer retention initiatives, loyalty programs, or membership strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn customer insights into actionable improvements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems, customer service tools, and customer data.
  • Experience identifying revenue opportunities through customer service, customer success, or retention initiatives.
  • Strong operational skills, with experience improving processes, implementing systems, and managing cross-functional projects.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • A creative, proactive mindset with a willingness to test new ideas.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, growing business.
  • A genuine passion for customer experience, wellness, and building community.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in boutique fitness, wellness, hospitality, or other multi-location consumer businesses.
  • Experience with membership or subscription-based business models.
  • Familiarity with customer lifecycle campaigns, marketing automation, and segmentation.
  • Experience driving retention improvements across physical retail or service locations.
  • Experience implementing live chat, SMS support, or customer service sales programs.

Our Puppy Sphere Values:

description: Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life.

raw.title: Digital Analytics Engineer
raw.excerpt: Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life.
raw.description:
Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.

We work hard, and have some fun along the way, too. You don’t have to take our word for it: The Boston Globe and Forbes have recognized us as a great place to work, and we’ve been honored for our commitment to innovation in the fintech space by Inc., HousingWire, and more!

In case you need any more convincing, we also provide competitive compensation, healthcare coverage, generous PTO, a meaningful equity package, and a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who you are:

As a Digital Analytics Engineer, you'll own how Hometap captures and governs its product and marketing event data. Today we track roughly 200 product events, and you'll be the person who manages that ecosystem by owning the event taxonomy and tracking plan, to keep the data flowing into our downstream tools trustworthy. You'll sit on the data engineering and analytics team and work closely with marketing, product, and engineering - all of whom interact with this data to make decisions.

This is a role for someone early in their analytics engineering career who cares about data quality, can turn messy tracking into a clear system, and is comfortable partnering across teams to get instrumentation right.

What you'll do:

  • Audit the current Segment inventory, consolidate duplicates and naming drift, and establish a governed object-action naming convention
  • Build and maintain the tracking plan, keeping it to a navigable size, and deprecating events deliberately as the product changes.
  • Stand up enforcement so standards are gated
  • Configure and manage Segment Protocols for schema validation and violation handling, and manage the sources feeding downstream tools
  • Advise on our hybrid capture model with product and engineering; determine if events should be server-side, client-side, or both
  • Partner with marketing, product, and engineering on what gets tracked and what it means, and translate their requirements into well-formed event specs
  • Document tracking standards, interact with teams so they instrument consistently, and run a review process for proposing, approving, and deprecating events
  • Build automated monitoring for schema conformance, event volume, and property completeness that catches naming drift, type mutation, and alert on shift before it corrupts downstream metrics

What you bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst, Data Analytics, or similar role
  • Experience with Segment or a similar customer data platform. Familiarity with the broader analytics landscape like Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, or GA4 is a plus
  • A solid grasp of event taxonomy and tracking-plan concepts, including object-action naming, controlled vocabularies, and property typing
  • SQL proficiency and comfort querying data in a cloud data warehouse
  • Working knowledge of JSON Schema and JavaScript
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD, and the instinct to treat tracking like code by wiring validation and tests into the pipeline
  • Ability to explain tracking standards clearly to marketing, product, and engineering partners and align non-technical stakeholders on why governance matters

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $120,000, depending on your experience, skills, location, and other factors. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, so you can share in our growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap is on a mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible. Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.
Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. All roles here are filled based solely on candidates’ qualifications and our business needs.

Hometap is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, pregnancy, marital, veteran, or disability status. If there is an accommodation that would support your ability to apply and interview with Hometap, please let us know by emailing .

Was du bei uns bewegen kannst

  • Als Teil eines agilen Projektteams berätst du unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Infrastruktur-Lösungen – von der Analyse bis zum Rollout.

  • Du fühlst dich in den Themenfeldern Infrastructure Engineering und Software-Entwicklung gleichermaßen zu Hause und freust dich, beide Perspektiven ins Team einzubringen.

  • Du entwickelst infrastrukturnahe Tools, z. B. im Kubernetes-Ökosystem, nach den individuellen Anforderungen deines Projekts (weiter) oder baust in einem cross-funktionalen Team Anwendungen für Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Du bringst die Expertise für qualitätsgetriebene Software-Entwicklung in dein Team ein und stellst mithilfe automatisierter Testing-Verfahren eine kontinuierliche Kontrolle und Weiterentwicklung sicher.

  • Im Team verfolgt ihr das gemeinsame Ziel, die bestmöglichen Lösungen für den Bedarf des Kunden zu entwickeln. Dabei denkt ihr über fachliche Grenzen und Projektphasen hinweg und übernehmt gemeinsam die Verantwortung.

In unseren Projekten verwenden wir häufig folgende Technologien:

  • Go, Python, Bash

  • Kubernetes, ECS, AKS, GKE, K3s, KubeEdge

  • Terraform, Ansible

  • AWS, Azure, GCP

  • CI/CD Tools (Gitlab, ArgoCD, GitHub, AzureDevOps)

  • Distributed Storage, LoadBalancing

Intern wie extern kannst du dich bei uns auf vielfältige Art einbringen: Deinen anfangs gewählten technologischen Schwerpunkt kannst du jederzeit verlagern. Als erfahrener Developer hast du außerdem die Möglichkeit, jüngere Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring zu unterstützen.

Requirements

Wer gut zu uns passen würde

Ob du ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen hast, ist für uns nebensächlich – für uns zählen deine fachlichen Skills und deine Persönlichkeit:

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Praxiserfahrung und Kenntnisse in mehreren der oben genannten Technologien.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten und sie in Bezug auf den Projekteinsatz zu prüfen. Dein Wissen teilst du gern mit deinen Kolleg:innen.

  • Du kannst gut priorisieren und hast ein Gespür für die richtige Balance zwischen Pragmatismus und Perfektionismus.

  • Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge auch nicht-technischen Ansprechpartner:innen vermitteln. Es ist dir ein Anliegen, ein tiefes Verständnis von den Perspektiven deiner Projektkolleg:innen und Kunden zu gewinnen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

VIP After-Hours Emergency Corporate Travel Consultant

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced VIP Corporate Travel Consultant to join our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team, delivering white-glove, personalized service to C-Suite executives and high-profile clients during after-hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday periods. This role is uniquely designed for a seasoned travel professional who thrives in high-pressure situations and understands that for our VIP clientele, exceptional service never sleeps.

As a VIP Emergency Customer Care Consultant, you will manage urgent and complex domestic and international travel requests, including air, hotel, car, and ground transportation, via Sabre GDS, while maintaining the highest standard of professionalism, discretion, and client satisfaction. You will serve as a trusted advisor and first point of contact when our most valued clients need assistance the most.

Before you begin your role, you will complete a four-week paid training program designed to boost your industry knowledge, train you on contract airfares, and sharpen your Sabre skills, ensuring you are fully equipped to deliver the VIP experience our clients expect around the clock.

**Please note that this is a remote after-hours position that requires working overnights, weekends, and holidays**

This position requires flexible hours and shift availability as determined by business need and client call volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, white-glove service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff during after-hours and emergency situations, ensuring all interactions are handled with the utmost professionalism and discretion.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, crafting bespoke travel itineraries tailored to the specific needs and elevated expectations of VIP and executive-level clients.
  • Coordinate urgent air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for complex domestic and international travel, often within time-sensitive and high-pressure timelines.
  • Expertly manage rerouting, exchanges, and itinerary changes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans and a seamless experience for the client from start to finish.
  • Proactively gather, retain, and apply client travel preferences and profiles to deliver a consistently personalized and anticipatory level of service.
  • Keep VIP clients informed of all necessary travel documents, visa requirements, and health requirements for international destinations, providing guidance with confidence and accuracy.
  • Proficiently handle ticketing, Phase IVs, and complex exchanges and changes involving both domestic and international fares.
  • Execute all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, PNR documentation and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and quality control, maintaining the highest degree of accuracy throughout.
  • Stay fully informed of airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements, applying this knowledge accurately and efficiently to all travel arrangements.
  • Demonstrate creative thinking and decisive problem-solving skills to provide optimal travel solutions in fast-paced, high-stakes situations.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with team members, Travel Managers, and Team Leaders through provided channels to ensure a united, consistent, and professional approach to VIP account management.
  • Complete all reservations accurately and in a timely manner, including post-trip follow-up and support where applicable.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent experience as a VIP or Executive Travel Agent, with a demonstrated ability to serve C-level executives and high-profile clients with discretion and professionalism.
  • 4+ years of recent experience in corporate travel management, with a thorough understanding of the unique needs and challenges of business travelers, particularly in emergency and after-hours scenarios.
  • Expert in managing complex, urgent, and time-sensitive travel requests with precision, including the ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to ensure seamless VIP travel experiences.
  • In-depth familiarity with Sabre GDS for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance, along with proficiency in ticketing procedures, scripting, and handling complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both domestic and international travel.
  • Comfortable and proficient using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams), travel booking tools (Concur, Deem), and various communication tools, with a strong technical aptitude and the ability to adapt to new technologies quickly.
  • Skilled in building long-term relationships with elite clientele by proactively gathering and retaining travel preferences, handling bespoke requests with discretion, and maintaining a comprehensive understanding of global geography and international destinations.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings, with strong attention to detail even in fast-paced, high-pressure situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a polished, professional, and empathetic demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A natural inclination to respond promptly to emergency travel requests, with the ability to handle high-stress situations, make quick and effective decisions, and provide expert guidance while consistently upholding the VIP standard of service.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!

  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Corporate Travel Consultant (Sandia Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

raw.title: Tik Tok Shop Affiliate Manager (UK Market)
raw.excerpt: About the roleWe’re looking for a TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to scale multiple UK TikTok Shops using creators, affiliate networks and TikTok Shop’s native tools.
raw.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to scale multiple UK TikTok Shops using creators, affiliate networks and TikTok Shop’s native tools. You’ll own the end-to-end affiliate engine: from setting up offers and commissions inside Seller Centre, to recruiting and managing creators, to working with TikTok Shop partner/affiliate agencies and building light automations to make everything run at scale. If you live and breathe TikTok, understand how creators think, and are comfortable in dashboards, spreadsheets and APIs, this is for you.

Key responsibilities
1. Strategy & growth for TikTok Shop UK
  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate strategy for our UK shops: commission structure, creator tiers, seeding, content angles and promo calendar.
    ● Build a clear roadmap to scale revenue via affiliates: from first creators, to hundreds+ of active partners generating daily sales.
    ● Align affiliate activity with wider promo events (e.g. seasonal campaigns, TikTok Shop mega sales, Black Friday etc.).
2. Affiliate Centre & Seller Centre ops
  • Own all work inside TikTok Shop Seller Centre, especially the Affiliate Centre:
    ○ Set up and optimise Affiliate Plans and commission rates (flat and optimised).
    ○ Use Find Creators, Open Collaboration, Manage Creators, Samples and Analytics to recruit and optimise at scale.
    ○ Configure and maintain product catalogues, tagging, and availability for creators.
    ● Ensure our shops are correctly enabled for affiliate, so creators can easily discover and apply to promote our products.
    ● Manage product whitelists/blacklists, exclusions and vertical-specific rules (e.g. food & drink).
3. Creator sourcing, onboarding & relationship management
  • Proactively source creators in the UK (and relevant markets) using TikTok Shop’s tools, TikTok search, and external databases/affiliate agencies.
    ● Build and manage a pipeline / CRM of creators: outreach, negotiation, onboarding, and retention.
    ● Create and maintain creator playbooks: key hooks, angles, claim language, USPs, example scripts and content guidelines.
    ● Monitor creator output and performance; identify top performers and upsell them to higher-tier commissions or exclusives.
4. Agency & partner management
  • Work with TikTok Shop Partner / affiliate agencies to support large-scale creator recruitment and campaign execution.
    ● Brief agencies clearly on goals, budgets, creative angles, product priorities and commission rules.
    ● Hold partners accountable for performance through clear KPIs and regular reporting (GMV, ROAS, CAC via affiliates, active creators, content volume etc.).
5. Automation & process building
  • Use Seller Centre features such as Campaign Auto-Registration to automatically enrol relevant products into TikTok Shop campaigns and events.
    ● Build light automations and workflows (e.g. via Google Sheets, Zapier/Make, TikTok Shop APIs or partner tools) to:
    ○ Sync data (orders, GMV, creator performance) into dashboards.
    ○ Flag top-performing creators and content automatically.
    ○ Trigger outreach sequences or commission changes for specific cohorts.
    ● Document all SOPs so the process can be repeated and scaled across multiple brands.
6. Performance analysis & reporting
  • Track and report on core affiliate metrics:
    ○ GMV, orders, AOV and conversion rate from affiliate traffic.
    ○ Number of active creators, content volume, CTR, view-through vs click-through sales.
    ○ Commission spend as a % of GMV and blended CAC.
    ● Run ongoing experiments: commission levels, bundles, hooks, thumbnails, posting times, creator niches.
    ● Provide clear weekly and monthly summaries with insights and actions, not just numbers.
7. Collaboration with paid & organic teams
  • Coordinate with paid media to boost top-performing creators/content via Spark Ads / TikTok ads, and to share winning hooks and creatives.
    ● Work with brand/content teams to ensure product pages, bundles and creative assets are optimised for TikTok Shop and affiliate use.
    ● Feed back VOICE OF CREATOR & VOICE OF CUSTOMER insights to improve offers, pricing, landing pages and product development.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Proven experience running TikTok Shop or social commerce affiliate programmes (brand, agency or network side).
  • Deep understanding of TikTok Shop Seller Centre & Affiliate Centre – commissions, creator discovery, samples, campaign tools and analytics.
  • Strong track record of scaling with creators: you’ve taken a shop/programme from low activity to a meaningful volume of affiliate-driven sales.
  • Confident with data and tools: Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, basic dashboards); comfortable learning new software quickly.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, especially for creator outreach and negotiation.
  • Highly organised, process-driven, and able to manage hundreds of creators and multiple brands without dropping balls.
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience working with TikTok Shop Partner agencies or influencer/affiliate agencies.
  • Experience in UK or EU e-commerce, especially FMCG / food & drink / CPG.
  • Basic understanding of TikTok ads and how affiliate and paid work together.
  • Familiarity with API-driven workflows and tools (TikTok Shop Partner APIs, reporting connectors, etc.).
  • Experience with other affiliate platforms (Impact, Awin, Refersion, etc.).

Corporate Travel Consultant - Philadelphia Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

raw.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Virginia Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We’re Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

As a company, we’re passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities. 

Why you'll love this role as an Infrastructure Manager at Civica

As an Infrastructure Manager within Civica's Infrastructure Services team, you will lead a geographically distributed team across the UK and India, responsible for delivering secure, resilient, scalable and cost-effective infrastructure services that underpin Civica's global operations. This is a critical leadership role for an experienced infrastructure professional who combines strong technical expertise with exceptional people management and delivery capabilities.

You will lead a team of Infrastructure Engineers and Senior Infrastructure Engineers, managing operational excellence, service reliability, infrastructure projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across a complex hybrid technology environment. Balancing strategic transformation programmes with day-to-day operational demands, you will ensure the business has the robust infrastructure foundation it needs to operate effectively every day.

This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in Civica's wider IT transformation journey, including major initiatives such as data centre exit programmes, cloud modernisation, infrastructure optimisation, automation and resilience improvements. You will also lead the delivery of cutting-edge infrastructure projects leveraging Microsoft Azure, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) technologies, containerised platforms and emerging AI-enabled infrastructure capabilities.

Requirements

Your key responsibilities include :

  • Lead and develop a geographically distributed Infrastructure team across the UK, India and APAC.
  • Manage priorities, resources and delivery across projects, operations, incidents and escalations.
  • Drive operational excellence across Azure, hybrid infrastructure, networking, storage, backup, monitoring, automation and resilience services.
  • Lead critical infrastructure incident response, service recovery and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure infrastructure services meet quality, security, governance and operational standards.
  • Support cloud transformation, data centre exit, M&A integration and infrastructure modernisation programmes.
  • Promote automation, service optimisation, FinOps and capacity management best practices.
  • Collaborate with Security, IAM, Network Services, Helpdesk and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise priorities.
  • Manage team performance, capability development and workforce planning.
  • Report on delivery progress, risks, dependencies and operational performance.

Your Essential competencies include:

  • Leadership of remote and geographically distributed teams.
  • Infrastructure delivery and operational management.
  • Resource, project and capacity planning.
  • Incident and escalation management.
  • People leadership, coaching and performance development.
  • Risk, dependency and stakeholder management.
  • Continuous improvement and service quality focus.
  • FinOps, optimisation and cost awareness.
  • Strong communication and decision-making skills.
  • Technical understanding of Azure and hybrid infrastructure environments.

Preferred Skills :

  • Managing global infrastructure or cloud engineering teams across multiple time zones.
  • Delivering infrastructure projects within fast-paced enterprise environments.
  • Leading teams through transformation, migration, data centre exit or M&A initiatives.
  • Improving service reliability, operational maturity and engineering practices.
  • Working with Security, Architecture, IAM and Operations teams to manage delivery and risk.
  • Knowledge of FinOps, resilience, disaster recovery, backup and capacity planning.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure, automation and platform services.
  • Building high-performing, accountable and inclusive engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience leading Infrastructure, Cloud, Platform Engineering or IT Operations teams in enterprise environments.
  • Proven success managing geographically distributed teams, operational services and project delivery.
  • Strong experience in resource, capacity, risk and dependency management.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, hybrid infrastructure, automation, resilience, disaster recovery and service management.
  • Relevant cloud, infrastructure, management or project delivery certifications desirable.

Why you'll love working with us

We're all different - and we love this about us.

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

As a company, we’re passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities. 

Why you'll love this role as an Infrastructure Manager at Civica

As an Infrastructure Manager within Civica's Infrastructure Services team, you will lead a geographically distributed team across the UK and India, responsible for delivering secure, resilient, scalable and cost-effective infrastructure services that underpin Civica's global operations. This is a critical leadership role for an experienced infrastructure professional who combines strong technical expertise with exceptional people management and delivery capabilities.

You will lead a team of Infrastructure Engineers and Senior Infrastructure Engineers, managing operational excellence, service reliability, infrastructure projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across a complex hybrid technology environment. Balancing strategic transformation programmes with day-to-day operational demands, you will ensure the business has the robust infrastructure foundation it needs to operate effectively every day.

This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in Civica's wider IT transformation journey, including major initiatives such as data centre exit programmes, cloud modernisation, infrastructure optimisation, automation and resilience improvements. You will also lead the delivery of cutting-edge infrastructure projects leveraging Microsoft Azure, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) technologies, containerised platforms and emerging AI-enabled infrastructure capabilities.

Requirements

Your key responsibilities include :

  • Lead and develop a geographically distributed Infrastructure team across the UK, India and APAC.
  • Manage priorities, resources and delivery across projects, operations, incidents and escalations.
  • Drive operational excellence across Azure, hybrid infrastructure, networking, storage, backup, monitoring, automation and resilience services.
  • Lead critical infrastructure incident response, service recovery and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure infrastructure services meet quality, security, governance and operational standards.
  • Support cloud transformation, data centre exit, M&A integration and infrastructure modernisation programmes.
  • Promote automation, service optimisation, FinOps and capacity management best practices.
  • Collaborate with Security, IAM, Network Services, Helpdesk and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise priorities.
  • Manage team performance, capability development and workforce planning.
  • Report on delivery progress, risks, dependencies and operational performance.

Your Essential competencies include:

  • Leadership of remote and geographically distributed teams.
  • Infrastructure delivery and operational management.
  • Resource, project and capacity planning.
  • Incident and escalation management.
  • People leadership, coaching and performance development.
  • Risk, dependency and stakeholder management.
  • Continuous improvement and service quality focus.
  • FinOps, optimisation and cost awareness.
  • Strong communication and decision-making skills.

  • Delivering infrastructure projects within fast-paced enterprise environments.
  • Leading teams through transformation, migration, data centre exit or M&A initiatives.
  • Improving service reliability, operational maturity and engineering practices.
  • Working with Security, Architecture, IAM and Operations teams to manage delivery and risk.
  • Knowledge of FinOps, resilience, disaster recovery, backup and capacity planning.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure, automation and platform services.
  • Building high-performing, accountable and inclusive engineering teams.

  • Proven success managing geographically distributed teams, operational services and project delivery.
  • Strong experience in resource, capacity, risk and dependency management.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, hybrid infrastructure, automation, resilience, disaster recovery and service management.

We're all different - and we love this about us.

If you're looking for a rewarding career where you can truly make an impact, we encourage you to apply today.

Our next start date is October. 29, with virtual training beginning November 2. Training will run for two weeks, Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM CST.

raw.description:
About the Project

DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.

The goal of this project is to help make technology more accessible for everyone and promote greater inclusion of Deaf and signing communities in the development of future technologies.

We believe that projects involving ASL, BASL, and the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities should include meaningful representation from the communities themselves. Our project team includes Deaf and Hard of Hearing professionals who are directly involved in the administration and development of the project.

Their perspectives help us make informed decisions, advocate for the interests of the community, and ensure that accessibility, cultural considerations, and participant experience are represented throughout the project.

What You’ll Do

Participants will record approximately 1,000 short ASL/BASL videos from home, including phrases, numbers, fingerspelling sequences, and conversational prompts.

Each recording is approximately 10 seconds long. Completing the full set is expected to take approximately 10 hours in total.

The project can be completed remotely from home using a compatible Apple device.

Compensation

$700 USD for completing the project according to the study guidelines.

This is a project-based opportunity and not a full-time employment position.

Who Can Participate

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older

  • Be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL) and/or Black American Sign Language (BASL)

  • Currently reside in the United States, excluding Texas, Illinois, and Washington

  • Be able to understand written English instructions

  • Be comfortable recording yourself on video

  • Have a suitable environment at home for recording

  • Have access to a compatible Apple device:

    • iPhone 12 or newer

    • iPad 9th Generation (2021) or newer

    • MacBook with M1 chip or newer

    • iMac with M1 chip or newer

Why Participate?

Your contribution will help support the development of technologies that better recognize and represent ASL, BASL, and diverse signing communities.

You'll participate entirely from home, complete the recordings on your own schedule according to the project instructions, and receive $700 USD upon successful completion of the project according to the study guidelines.

How to Apply

Click Apply and complete the short application.

Our DataForce team will review your information and contact eligible participants with the next steps and detailed project instructions.

raw.title: Collecte de données vocales – France et outre-mer
raw.excerpt: En quoi consiste le projet ? L’objectif de ce projet vise à collecter des enregistrements vocaux de personnes de langue maternelle française afin d’améliorer les technologies d’assistant vocal.
raw.description:
En quoi consiste le projet ?

L’objectif de ce projet vise à collecter des enregistrements vocaux de personnes de langue maternelle française afin d’améliorer les technologies d’assistant vocal.

Description de la tâche :

Pour ce projet, nous recherchons une grande variété de locuteurs natifs de langue française (France et outre-mer) avec divers accents régionaux. Les participants enregistreront de courtes phrases d’activation et des énoncés scriptés généralement utilisés lors d’interactions avec un assistant vocal, en suivant les instructions fournies.

Qui peut participer à l’étude ?

Pour participer, vous devez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • Avoir 18 ans ou plus.

  • Être né(e) et vivre en France ou outre-mer.

  • Être de langue maternelle française, de n’importe quelle région de France ou outre-mer.

  • Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais, car toutes les instructions du projet seront en anglais.

  • Être en mesure d’utiliser un téléphone portable pour ce projet.

  • Pouvoir utiliser un casque filaire ou le microphone de l’appareil pour enregistrer des phrases.

  • Avoir accès à un environnement intérieur calme pour effectuer les enregistrements.

    Notes:

    • Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous recherchons des participants issus de groupes démographiques spécifiques afin de contribuer au développement d’une technologie impartiale qui soit représentative de tous. Certains groupes sont déjà complets, mais nous recherchons toujours des voix masculines avec des accents du Nord, du Nord-est, du Sud-ouest et du Sud-est de la France.

    • Nous recherchons aussi des participants issus d’outre-mer: Guadeloupe (971), Martinique (972), Guyane (973), La Réunion (974), Mayotte (976), Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (975), Saint-Barthélemy (977), Saint-Martin (978), Wallis-et-Futuna (986), Polynésie française (987), Nouvelle-Calédonie (988), Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (984) et Clipperton (989).

Veuillez noter que ce projet est également ouvert aux participantsâgés de 7 à 17 ans. Pour plus de détails, veuillez vous référer à ce formulaire :Gardenia Speech Collection - France (Minors) | DataForce Community

Où le projet a-t-il lieu ?

C’est un projet entièrement à distance. Vous pouvez participer depuis n’importe où en France ou outre-mer.

Combien de temps dure-t-il ?

La durée estimée de la tâche d’enregistrement est de 30 minutes.

Quel est le montant de la rémunération ?

Vous recevrez $ 33 USD pour vos livrables entièrement terminés et acceptés.

Programme général de prime de parrainage

Nous offrons une prime de parrainage de $ 15 USD pour chaque participant adulte que vous recommandez pour le projet et qui le termine avec succès.

Comment parrainer quelqu’un :

- Partagez ce lien d’inscription avec vos amis et votre famille
- Lors de leur inscription, ils doivent répondre « Referral» (Recommandation) à la question « How did you find out about this opportunity? » (Comment avez-vous pris connaissance de cette opportunité ?) et indiquer votre nom et votre adresse e-mail dans les champs : Prénom, Nom et adresse e-mail.

Comme mode de paiement, nous proposons le Virement bancaire, PayPal et la Carte cadeau, selon votre préférence.

Veuillez noter que notre équipe d’assurance qualité examinera toutes les soumissions pour s’assurer qu’elles respectent les exigences spécifiques du projet. L’équipe du projet vous enverra des commentaires une fois le processus de contrôle qualité terminé.

Des questions ou des doutes ?

Si vous avez des doutes ou des questions, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à:

Si vous souhaitez participer et que vous remplissez les conditions d’éligibilité ci-dessus, veuillez cliquer sur Postuler ici et remplir le formulaire d’inscription.
