raw.description:
JAVA ENGINEERING LEAD – CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION MANAGEMENT (ENGINEER II/III)
Brand, Marketing & Communications | Mutual of Omaha Information Services

Mutual of Omaha is expanding its Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) program to launch a newly approved, enterprise-wide Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. This is not a backfill – it is a new role created to help build something from the ground up. The CCM platform will give our customers control over how they receive information from Mutual of Omaha, moving statements and benefit communications that were traditionally printed and mailed to secure digital delivery. The result: a better customer experience and meaningful cost savings for the company.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    • Engineer III - $150,000 - $163,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Time Off: Up to 15 days of vacation annually, plus 11 paid holidays including 2 floating holidays
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with occasional in-person team events (approximately once per year for 3–4 days)
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Platform Engineering Leadership: Serve as the overall engineering lead for the CCM platform, establishing and enforcing engineering standards, patterns, and practices across interconnected applications to ensure they are scalable, maintainable, and ready for future growth.
  • Solution Leadership: Act as Solution Lead for the CCM discovery team and future delivery teams, coordinating closely with other Solution Leads to align designs, dependencies, and delivery across the program.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend roughly 40–50% of your time coding – building greenfield applications and enhancing and scaling existing applications using Java, MuleSoft, and AWS.
  • Discovery & Build-vs-Buy Analysis: Assess the capabilities and gaps of existing applications, estimate the effort to make them enterprise-ready, and evaluate vendor solutions to recommend where to build versus buy. Findings will directly shape the 2027 critical path plan.
  • Platform Capabilities: Help design and deliver core CCM capabilities, including a decision engine, a customer consent and preference center, workflow management, and analytics tracking – along with integrations to Salesforce and third-party tools.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor and guide engineers on the team and partner with QA, business analysts, and technical leadership within a SAFe Agile environment (three-week sprints, quarterly PI planning).
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience as a Solution Lead, Engineering Lead, or Technical Lead.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and AWS cloud services.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or similar integration platforms, including API design and system-to-system integration.
  • Proven track record of building applications from scratch and taking them from concept to production.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing existing applications for enterprise-wide use.
  • Ability to define and uphold engineering standards across multiple applications and teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub.
  • Experience leading and mentoring other engineers.
  • Comfortable working in SAFe Agile environments and contributing to PI planning within Agile Release Trains (ART).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Vue.js.
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering, including using AI agents in the development process.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience with customer communication management, digital document delivery, or consent and preference management solutions.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing vendor solutions.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at . Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking the status.

Stay Safe from Job Scams
Mutual of Omaha only accepts applications from mutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers without conducting interviews. For more details, check our Hiring FAQs. Stay alert for scams and apply securely!

raw.description:
Work Location: United States; Remote

We are currently looking for contributors for our Ronia Raw Photo Collection Project.

What is the project about?

We invite photographers, photo hobbyists, visual creators, and anyone passionate about photography to participate in our RAW Photo Collection project.

Do you regularly capture high-quality photos in RAW format to expand your photo library? If the answer is yes, this project allows you to earn extra income by contributing your photos to the development of advanced AI and computer vision technologies. Your images can have a real-world impact beyond your personal library.

Task Description:

Participants may submit both existing photos from their personal archives and newly captured images in RAW format. We’re looking for a wide variety of subjects, styles, lighting conditions, and environments—including nature, events, everyday scenes, objects, and more.

Photos may be captured in RAW and other supported formats using eligible iPhones or digital cameras. Uploading is quick and easy via our mobile app or browser-based data collection tool.

We will be collecting the following types of photos:

  1. RAW Images: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device.

  2. Image Pairs: pairs of identical unedited photos, with specific objects present in one and absent in the other photo.

Accepted Formats:
The photos should be native RAW and DNG where applicable (including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF). These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken.

All submitted photos must be original and taken by you. Photos downloaded from the internet or generated using AI will not be accepted.

Intellectual Property Rights:Participants retain full ownership of all submitted photos, which will be used exclusively for internal purposes by our client and will not be distributed, or published.

Who is eligible?

To participate you should meet the following qualifying criteria:

  • Be 18 years or older.

  • Be a resident of the United States.

  • Be able to upload RAW images or a pair of two images following our instructions.

  • All images should be taken with one of the following devices:

    • iPhone models accepted:

      • 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max

      • 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max

      • 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max

        All accepted iPhone models should run iOS 14.3 or later.

        No other smartphones are permitted.

    • Digital Cameras

      • Full-frame mirrorless

      • Full-frame DSLR

      • APS-C mirrorless

      • APS-C DSL

Where is the project taking place?

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home or preferred location within the US.

Please note the following location-based limitations:

  • Public Images

Public Images are photos taken in publicly accessible places and/or featuring identifiable individuals. We can accept Public Images only if they were captured in the following U.S. states: AL, AK, AZ, AR, FL, GA, HI, ID, KS, LA, ME, MA, MI, MS, MO, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, VT, WV, WI, WY.

  • Non-Public Images

Non-Public Images (for example, photos taken in private settings without public access) are accepted from all U.S. states, except IL, WA, and TX.

Image

How much is the compensation?

You will receive $1.50 USD per each accepted photo. Participants may submit as many photos as they wish across all open categories. Please note that some categories may have submission limits, and once a category is filled, it will be closed. Submissions are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.

Example earnings:
50 accepted photos x $1,50 = $75 USD

100 accepted photos x $1.50 = $150 USD

Please note that all submissions will be checked by our Quality Assurance team, and compensation will be provided for submitted and accepted photos. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.

As payment methods we offer Wire Transfer, PayPal, Gift Card and Check according to your preference.

Referral Bonus Program
We offer a referral bonus of $15 USD for each participant you refer to the project who submits a minimum of 50 accepted photos.

Image

If you have any doubts or questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at:

raw.excerpt: Who We AreKLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies.
raw.description:
Who We Are

KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our technology-enabled services and software help these law firms, corporations and agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries helps clients with their litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs all around the world.

Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.

KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500. Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and Relativity’s 1st Service Provider partner, and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

KLDiscovery is seeking a Strategic Account Executive to drive net-new logo acquisition for our Legal Technologies business across the Americas. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, focused on personally sourcing, qualifying, and closing new enterprise accounts that have not previously purchased KLD eDiscovery and managed review services. The successful candidate is a proven enterprise hunter who can open and win complex, multi-stakeholder deals, then partner with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition to delivery. This role carries an individual new-business revenue target and reports to the Chief Revenue Officer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospect, identify, and qualify net-new and current enterprise accounts across law firms, corporations, and government entities within an assigned territory.
  • Build and maintain a robust personal pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, retention, and partnership with Marketing and Sales Development.
  • Manage complex, multi-month sales cycles from initial contact through close, engaging stakeholders across Legal, IT, Privacy, Procurement, and Finance.
  • Develop and deliver tailored value propositions, presentations, and proposals that address client business and legal challenges.
  • Negotiate pricing, scope, and contract terms within approved commercial guidelines, defending value rather than discounting.
  • Achieve or exceed an assigned individual new-logo revenue target of $5M in annual contract value.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of activity, pipeline, and forecasts in Salesforce, sustaining healthy pipeline coverage.
  • Partner with Client Success and Delivery to ensure flawless onboarding and a strong foundation for future expansion of newly signed accounts.
  • Represent KLDiscovery at industry conferences and events (e.g., Legalweek, ILTACON), building brand presence and relationships.
  • Provide field and competitive intelligence to Product and leadership to inform packaging, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience in legal technology and/or services with a sustained record of personally attaining or exceeding individual annual quotas of at least $5M.
  • Deep knowledge of the legal technology, eDiscovery, or litigation-support industry.
  • Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition and client retention personally sourcing and closing net-new enterprise accounts, not solely growing an inherited book of business.
  • Experience managing complex, enterprise sales cycles (3–12+ months) involving multiple decision-makers across Procurement, IT, Privacy, and Legal.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-level proposals and presentations.
  • Trained in and consistently applying a structured sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and Challenger Sale principles to qualify opportunities and lead value-based, insight-driven customer conversations.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM systems and modern sales tooling.
  • Willingness to travel for client meetings and industry events.

Preferred

  • Understanding of legal workflows, including litigation, regulatory and internal investigations, compliance, and antitrust / second requests.
  • Background in professional services or technology-enabled services sales.
  • Familiarity with adjacent offerings such as cyber incident response, information governance, and managed review.
  • Prior experience in a private-equity-backed or high-growth organization.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, JD, or equivalent qualification preferred.

Our Mission & Values

Our Mission: We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

These four values guide how we operate, make decisions, and work together every day.

  • Client is Always in the Room - We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

  • Own the Outcome - We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients, and each other.

  • Better Every Day - We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

  • Deliver Results Together - We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, discipline, and termination. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and experience.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING FOR KLD

At KLD, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that when our employees feel supported, valued, and empowered, they can thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can grow your career, make meaningful contributions, and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our competitive benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being and success. Depending on your location, these may include comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement and financial programs, paid time off and leave options, employee assistance resources, and professional development opportunities.

We also embrace flexibility, offering remote work opportunities for most employees to support work-life balance while keeping our teams connected and collaborative. Certain roles may require an office-based or hybrid schedule based on business and operational needs.

raw.description:
At DataForce, we are seeking professional male and female voice talents for 2 projects involving narrative voice recordings to support the development of text-to-speech (TTS) technology.

As part of the casting process, applicants are required to submit a voice sample for evaluation. Please note that voice samples will be used solely for screening and selection purposes. Sample submissions are not compensated.

Languages required:

English (US)

Spanish (US)

English (UK)

German (Germany)

French (France)

Spanish (Spain)

Italian (Italy)

Polish (Poland)

Project Scope

Selected voice talents will be presented to our client for consideration for 2 different TTS projects each requiring 3-6 hours of scripted audio. Recordings will be completed through our proprietary recording platform, Media Director.

Project Mulberry - The voice recordings made in this project will be used in creation of a TTS voice capable of narrating audiobooks. A separate buyout fee is included in the rate for this project and you will be asked to sign an Assignment of Rights Agreement.

Project Silkroad - The voice recordings made in this project will be used as data for training and testing existing TTS models. (No buyout fee will be offered for this project since voice cloning is not included).

Compensation:

Project compensation, including recording fee and a buyout fee (if applicable), will be discussed with shortlisted candidates and confirmed upon selection.

Requirements:

Professional recording experience

  • Idiomatic fluency in the target language: English (US), Spanish (US), English (UK), German (Germany), French (France), Spanish (Spain), Italian (Italy), Polish (Poland). Good English communication and comprehension skills

-Age 18+

  • Ability to record in a professional-quality home studio or access to a professional recording studio

-Wired microphone

Casting sample requirements:

  • A 30–60-second voice sample in WAV (.wav) format

-A narrative delivery style

  • Voice only (no background music or sound effects)
  • The sample must be recorded entirely in the target language you are applying for
